   7/**
   8 * The catalog of error types this API can return. Each becomes the "type" URI of an
   9 * RFC 9457 problem document, so clients branch on a stable identifier, never on the
  10 * human-readable title or detail.
  11 */
  12public enum ProblemType {
  13
  14    INVALID_REQUEST("invalid-request", HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "The request is not valid"),
  15    UNAUTHORIZED("unauthorized", HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED, "Authentication is required"),
  16    INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE("insufficient-scope", HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN, "The access token lacks a required scope"),
  17    NOT_FOUND("not-found", HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "The resource does not exist"),
  18    IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_MISSING("idempotency-key-missing", HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
  19            "An Idempotency-Key header is required"),
  20    IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED("idempotency-key-reused", HttpStatus.UNPROCESSABLE_CONTENT,
  21            "The Idempotency-Key was already used for a different request"),
  22    PRECONDITION_REQUIRED("precondition-required", HttpStatus.PRECONDITION_REQUIRED,
  23            "An If-Match header is required"),
  24    PRECONDITION_FAILED("precondition-failed", HttpStatus.PRECONDITION_FAILED, "The resource has changed"),
  25    ORDER_NOT_CANCELLABLE("order-not-cancellable", HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
  26            "The order can no longer be canceled"),
  27    ORDER_NOT_REPLACEABLE("order-not-replaceable", HttpStatus.CONFLICT, "The order can no longer be changed"),
  28    INSUFFICIENT_BUYING_POWER("insufficient-buying-power", HttpStatus.UNPROCESSABLE_CONTENT,
  29            "The account does not have enough buying power"),
  30    INSUFFICIENT_POSITION("insufficient-position", HttpStatus.UNPROCESSABLE_CONTENT,
  31            "The account does not hold enough of the instrument"),
  32    INSTRUMENT_NOT_TRADABLE("instrument-not-tradable", HttpStatus.UNPROCESSABLE_CONTENT,
  33            "The instrument cannot be traded this way"),
  34    TRADING_LIMIT_EXCEEDED("trading-limit-exceeded", HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
  35            "The order exceeds the trading limit delegated to this client"),
  36    UNSUPPORTED_API_VERSION("unsupported-api-version", HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
  37            "The requested API version is not supported"),
  38    RATE_LIMITED("rate-limited", HttpStatus.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS, "Too many requests");
  39
  40    /** Problem type URIs resolve to human-readable documentation for each error. */
  41    public static final String BASE = "https://docs.brokerage.example/problems/";
  42
  43    private final String slug;
  44    private final HttpStatus status;
  45    private final String title;
  46
  47    ProblemType(String slug, HttpStatus status, String title) {
  48        this.slug = slug;
  49        this.status = status;
  50        this.title = title;
  51    }
  52
  53    public URI uri() {
  54        return URI.create(BASE + slug);
  55    }
  56
  57    public HttpStatus status() {
  58        return status;
  59    }
  60
  61    public String title() {
  62        return title;
  63    }
  64}

   3/** Raised when a client has used up its request quota for the current window. */
   4public class RateLimitedException extends ApiException {
   5
   6    private final long retryAfterSeconds;
   7
   8    public RateLimitedException(String policy, long retryAfterSeconds) {
   9        super(ProblemType.RATE_LIMITED, "The " + policy
  10                + " request quota for this client is used up; retry in " + retryAfterSeconds + " seconds");
  11        this.retryAfterSeconds = retryAfterSeconds;
  12    }
  13
  14    public long retryAfterSeconds() {

   1package com.example.brokerage.api.platform;
   2
   3import java.time.Clock;
   4import java.util.Map;
   5import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
   6
   7import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
   8import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
   9
  10import org.springframework.boot.context.properties.ConfigurationProperties;
  11import org.springframework.http.HttpMethod;
  12import org.springframework.security.core.Authentication;
  13import org.springframework.security.core.context.SecurityContextHolder;
  14import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
  15import org.springframework.web.servlet.HandlerInterceptor;
  16
  17/**
  18 * A fixed-window rate limiter per client, with two policies: "default" for every request
  19 * and a stricter "orders" policy for requests that change orders. Every response
  20 * advertises the policy and what is left of it, using the RateLimit-Policy and RateLimit
  21 * fields from the IETF httpapi working group's draft, so well-behaved clients can slow
  22 * down before they are refused.
  23 */
  24@Component
  25public class RateLimiter implements HandlerInterceptor {
  26
  27    @ConfigurationProperties("brokerage.rate-limit")
  28    public record Quotas(int requestsPerMinute, int orderChangesPerMinute) {
  29        public Quotas {
  30            requestsPerMinute = requestsPerMinute > 0 ? requestsPerMinute : 120;
  31            orderChangesPerMinute = orderChangesPerMinute > 0 ? orderChangesPerMinute : 30;
  32        }
  33    }
  34
  35    private static final int WINDOW_SECONDS = 60;
  36
  37    private final Quotas quotas;
  38    private final Clock clock;
  39    private final Map<String, Window> windows = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
  40
  41    public RateLimiter(Quotas quotas) {
  42        this.quotas = quotas;
  43        this.clock = Clock.systemUTC();
  44    }
  45
  46    @Override
  47    public boolean preHandle(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response, Object handler) {
  48        Authentication caller = SecurityContextHolder.getContext().getAuthentication();
  49        if (caller == null || !caller.isAuthenticated()) {
  50            return true;
  51        }
  52        boolean changesOrders = !HttpMethod.GET.matches(request.getMethod())
  53                && request.getRequestURI().contains("/orders");
  54        String policy = changesOrders ? "orders" : "default";
  55        int quota = changesOrders ? quotas.orderChangesPerMinute() : quotas.requestsPerMinute();
  56
  57        long now = clock.instant().getEpochSecond();
  58        long windowStart = now - (now % WINDOW_SECONDS);
  59        Window window = windows.compute(caller.getName() + "|" + policy,
  60                (key, existing) -> existing == null || existing.start() != windowStart
  61                        ? new Window(windowStart, 1) : new Window(windowStart, existing.used() + 1));
  62
  63        long resetIn = windowStart + WINDOW_SECONDS - now;
  64        int remaining = Math.max(0, quota - window.used());
  65        response.setHeader("RateLimit-Policy", "\"%s\";q=%d;w=%d".formatted(policy, quota, WINDOW_SECONDS));
  66        response.setHeader("RateLimit", "\"%s\";r=%d;t=%d".formatted(policy, remaining, resetIn));
  67        if (window.used() > quota) {
  68            throw new RateLimitedException(policy, resetIn);
  69        }
  70        return true;
  71    }
  72
  73    private record Window(long start, int used) {
  74    }
  75}

   1package com.example.brokerage.api.platform;
   2
   3import java.io.IOException;
   4import java.util.UUID;
   5import java.util.regex.Pattern;
   6
   7import jakarta.servlet.FilterChain;
   8import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
   9import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
  10import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
  11
  12import org.slf4j.MDC;
  13import org.springframework.core.Ordered;
  14import org.springframework.core.annotation.Order;
  15import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
  16import org.springframework.web.filter.OncePerRequestFilter;
  17
  18/**
  19 * Gives every request an ID: the caller's X-Request-Id if it is well formed, otherwise a
  20 * new UUID. The ID is echoed in the response, written to every log line through the MDC,
  21 * and included in every problem document, so a support ticket can quote one value.
  22 */
  23@Component
  24@Order(Ordered.HIGHEST_PRECEDENCE)
  25public class RequestIdFilter extends OncePerRequestFilter {
  26
  27    public static final String HEADER = "X-Request-Id";
  28    private static final String ATTRIBUTE = RequestIdFilter.class.getName();
  29    private static final Pattern SAFE = Pattern.compile("[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,64}");
  30
  31    @Override
  32    protected void doFilterInternal(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response,
  33            FilterChain chain) throws ServletException, IOException {
  34        String supplied = request.getHeader(HEADER);
  35        String id = supplied != null && SAFE.matcher(supplied).matches()
  36                ? supplied : UUID.randomUUID().toString();
  37        request.setAttribute(ATTRIBUTE, id);
  38        response.setHeader(HEADER, id);
  39        MDC.put("requestId", id);
  40        try {
  41            chain.doFilter(request, response);
  42        } finally {
  43            MDC.remove("requestId");
  44        }
  45    }
  46
  47    public static String currentId(HttpServletRequest request) {
  48        Object id = request.getAttribute(ATTRIBUTE);
  49        return id != null ? id.toString() : null;
  50    }
  51}

   1package com.example.brokerage.api.platform;
   2
   3import java.util.List;
   4
   5import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
   6import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
   7
   8import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Qualifier;
   9import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;
  10import org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean;
  11import org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration;
  12import org.springframework.http.HttpMethod;
  13import org.springframework.security.access.AccessDeniedException;
  14import org.springframework.security.config.Customizer;
  15import org.springframework.security.config.annotation.web.builders.HttpSecurity;
  16import org.springframework.security.config.annotation.web.configurers.AbstractHttpConfigurer;
  17import org.springframework.security.config.http.SessionCreationPolicy;
  18import org.springframework.security.core.AuthenticationException;
  19import org.springframework.security.oauth2.server.resource.web.BearerTokenAuthenticationEntryPoint;
  20import org.springframework.security.oauth2.server.resource.web.access.BearerTokenAccessDeniedHandler;
  21import org.springframework.security.web.AuthenticationEntryPoint;
  22import org.springframework.security.web.SecurityFilterChain;
  23import org.springframework.security.web.access.AccessDeniedHandler;
  24import org.springframework.web.servlet.HandlerExceptionResolver;
  25
  26/**
  27 * OAuth 2.1 resource server. Every operation requires one scope; the rules below are the
  28 * single place where an operation's required scope is decided.
  29 *
  30 * <pre>
  31 *   market-data:read   instruments, quotes, option chains
  32 *   accounts:read      accounts, balances, positions, transactions
  33 *   orders:read        orders, order previews, the order event stream
  34 *   orders:write       placing, changing and canceling orders
  35 * </pre>
  36 */
  37@Configuration(proxyBeanMethods = false)
  38public class SecurityConfig {
  39
  40    public static final String MARKET_DATA_READ = "SCOPE_market-data:read";
  41    public static final String ACCOUNTS_READ = "SCOPE_accounts:read";
  42    public static final String ORDERS_READ = "SCOPE_orders:read";
  43    public static final String ORDERS_WRITE = "SCOPE_orders:write";
  44
  45    /** Discovery documents that anyone may read, with or without a token. */
  46    private static final String[] PUBLIC = { "/", "/openapi.yaml", "/actuator/health/**",
  47            "/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource" };
  48
  49    @Bean
  50    SecurityFilterChain api(HttpSecurity http, ProblemResponses problems,
  51            @Value("${spring.security.oauth2.resourceserver.jwt.issuer-uri}") String issuer)
  52            throws Exception {
  53        return http
  54                .authorizeHttpRequests(auth -> auth
  55                        .requestMatchers(HttpMethod.GET, PUBLIC).permitAll()
  56                        .requestMatchers(HttpMethod.HEAD, PUBLIC).permitAll()
  57                        .requestMatchers(HttpMethod.GET, "/instruments/**").hasAuthority(MARKET_DATA_READ)
  58                        .requestMatchers(HttpMethod.GET, "/accounts/*/orders/**", "/accounts/*/order-events")
  59                            .hasAuthority(ORDERS_READ)
  60                        .requestMatchers(HttpMethod.POST, "/accounts/*/order-previews")
  61                            .hasAuthority(ORDERS_READ)
  62                        .requestMatchers("/accounts/*/orders/**").hasAuthority(ORDERS_WRITE)
  63                        .requestMatchers(HttpMethod.GET, "/accounts/**").hasAuthority(ACCOUNTS_READ)
  64                        .anyRequest().denyAll())
  65                .oauth2ResourceServer(server -> server
  66                        .jwt(Customizer.withDefaults())
  67                        // RFC 9728: publish which authorization server and scopes this API uses.
  68                        .protectedResourceMetadata(metadata -> metadata.protectedResourceMetadataCustomizer(
  69                                resource -> resource.resourceName("Brokerage API")
  70                                        .authorizationServer(issuer)
  71                                        .tlsClientCertificateBoundAccessTokens(false)
  72                                        .scopes(scopes -> scopes.addAll(List.of("market-data:read",
  73                                                "accounts:read", "orders:read", "orders:write")))))
  74                        .authenticationEntryPoint(problems)
  75                        .accessDeniedHandler(problems))
  76                // Bearer tokens are sent explicitly, never automatically like cookies, so
  77                // there is no cross-site request forgery to defend against, and no session.
  78                .csrf(AbstractHttpConfigurer::disable)
  79                .sessionManagement(session -> session.sessionCreationPolicy(SessionCreationPolicy.STATELESS))
  80                .build();
  81    }
  82
  83    /**
  84     * 401 and 403 responses keep the standard WWW-Authenticate header (RFC 6750) and get the
  85     * same problem-document body as every other error, by handing the exception to the MVC
  86     * exception handling in {@link ApiExceptionHandler}.
  87     */
  88    @Bean
  89    ProblemResponses problemResponses(
  90            @Qualifier("handlerExceptionResolver") HandlerExceptionResolver resolver) {
  91        return new ProblemResponses(resolver);
  92    }
  93
  94    public static final class ProblemResponses implements AuthenticationEntryPoint, AccessDeniedHandler {
  95
  96        private final HandlerExceptionResolver resolver;
  97        private final BearerTokenAuthenticationEntryPoint challenge =
  98                new BearerTokenAuthenticationEntryPoint();
  99        private final BearerTokenAccessDeniedHandler denied = new BearerTokenAccessDeniedHandler();
 100
 101        ProblemResponses(HandlerExceptionResolver resolver) {
 102            this.resolver = resolver;
 103        }
 104
 105        @Override
 106        public void commence(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response,
 107                AuthenticationException ex) {
 108            challenge.commence(request, response, ex);
 109            resolver.resolveException(request, response, null, ex);
 110        }
 111
 112        @Override
 113        public void handle(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response,
 114                AccessDeniedException ex) {
 115            denied.handle(request, response, ex);
 116            resolver.resolveException(request, response, null, ex);
 117        }
 118    }
 119}

   1package com.example.brokerage.api.platform;
   2
   3import java.net.URI;
   4import java.time.ZonedDateTime;
   5
   6import org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration;
   7import org.springframework.web.accept.StandardApiVersionDeprecationHandler;
   8import org.springframework.web.servlet.config.annotation.ApiVersionConfigurer;
   9import org.springframework.web.servlet.config.annotation.InterceptorRegistry;
  10import org.springframework.web.servlet.config.annotation.WebMvcConfigurer;
  11
  12/**
  13 * API versioning and request interceptors.
  14 *
  15 * <p>Clients choose a version with the API-Version request header. Version 1 is the
  16 * default so that existing clients keep working, but it is deprecated: every version 1
  17 * response carries Deprecation (RFC 9745) and Sunset (RFC 8594) headers, plus a link to
  18 * the migration guide. Version 2 differs only in the shape of a quote.
  19 */
  20@Configuration(proxyBeanMethods = false)
  21public class WebConfig implements WebMvcConfigurer {
  22
  23    public static final String VERSION_HEADER = "API-Version";
  24
  25    private final RateLimiter rateLimiter;
  26
  27    public WebConfig(RateLimiter rateLimiter) {
  28        this.rateLimiter = rateLimiter;
  29    }
  30
  31    @Override
  32    public void configureApiVersioning(ApiVersionConfigurer versions) {
  33        StandardApiVersionDeprecationHandler deprecations = new StandardApiVersionDeprecationHandler();
  34        deprecations.configureVersion("1")
  35                .setDeprecationDate(ZonedDateTime.parse("2026-09-01T00:00:00Z"))
  36                .setSunsetDate(ZonedDateTime.parse("2027-03-01T00:00:00Z"))
  37                .setSunsetLink(URI.create("https://docs.brokerage.example/migrations/v2"));
  38
  39        versions.useRequestHeader(VERSION_HEADER)
  40                .addSupportedVersions("1", "2")
  41                .setDefaultVersion("1")
  42                .setDeprecationHandler(deprecations);
  43    }
  44
  45    @Override
  46    public void addInterceptors(InterceptorRegistry registry) {
  47        registry.addInterceptor(rateLimiter).addPathPatterns("/accounts/**", "/instruments/**");
  48    }
  49}

  10/**
  11 * Something that can be traded: a stock, an ETF, or an option contract. The ID is
  12 * opaque: clients store it and send it back, but never take it apart.
  13 *
  14 * @param multiplier shares controlled by one unit: 1 for stocks, 100 for a US equity option
  15 * @param option     present only for option contracts
  16 */
  17@Relation(collectionRelation = "instruments", itemRelation = "instrument")
  18public record Instrument(String id, String symbol, String name, Type type, String exchange,
  19        String currency, boolean tradable, boolean fractionable, BigDecimal multiplier, OptionTerms option) {
  20
  21    public enum Type { EQUITY, ETF, OPTION }
  22
  23    public enum Right { CALL, PUT }
  24
  25    /** The contract terms of an option. */
  26    public record OptionTerms(String underlyingId, String underlyingSymbol, Right right,
  27            BigDecimal strike, LocalDate expiration, String style) {
  28    }
  29
  30    @JsonIgnore // otherwise Jackson would also write a boolean "option" property
  31    public boolean isOption() {
  32        return type == Type.OPTION;
  33    }
  34}

   1package com.example.brokerage.api.market;
   2
   3import static org.springframework.hateoas.server.mvc.WebMvcLinkBuilder.linkTo;
   4import static org.springframework.hateoas.server.mvc.WebMvcLinkBuilder.methodOn;
   5
   6import java.time.LocalDate;
   7import java.util.List;
   8import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;
   9
  10import com.example.brokerage.api.market.Instrument.Type;
  11import com.example.brokerage.api.market.Quotes.Quote;
  12import com.example.brokerage.api.market.Quotes.QuoteV1;
  13
  14import org.springframework.format.annotation.DateTimeFormat;
  15import org.springframework.hateoas.CollectionModel;
  16import org.springframework.hateoas.EntityModel;
  17import org.springframework.http.CacheControl;
  18import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
  19import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.GetMapping;
  20import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PathVariable;
  21import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestParam;
  22import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController;
  23import org.springframework.web.context.request.WebRequest;
  24
  25/**
  26 * Instruments, quotes and option chains. Scope: market-data:read.
  27 */
  28@RestController
  29public class InstrumentController {
  30
  31    private final MarketData market;
  32
  33    public InstrumentController(MarketData market) {
  34        this.market = market;
  35    }
  36
  37    @GetMapping("/instruments")
  38    public CollectionModel<EntityModel<Instrument>> search(
  39            @RequestParam(required = false) String symbol, @RequestParam(required = false) Type type) {
  40        List<EntityModel<Instrument>> found = market.search(symbol, type).stream()
  41                .map(this::toModel)
  42                .toList();
  43        return CollectionModel.of(found,
  44                linkTo(methodOn(InstrumentController.class).search(symbol, type)).withSelfRel().expand());
  45    }
  46
  47    @GetMapping("/instruments/{instrumentId}")
  48    public EntityModel<Instrument> instrument(@PathVariable String instrumentId) {
  49        return toModel(market.instrument(instrumentId));
  50    }
  51
  52    /** Version 1 of a quote (deprecated; see WebConfig). */
  53    @GetMapping(path = "/instruments/{instrumentId}/quote", version = "1")
  54    public ResponseEntity<EntityModel<QuoteV1>> quoteV1(@PathVariable String instrumentId,
  55            WebRequest request) {
  56        Instrument instrument = market.instrument(instrumentId);
  57        MarketData.Tick tick = market.tick(instrumentId);
  58        return quoteResponse(instrument, tick, QuoteV1.of(instrument, tick), request);
  59    }
  60
  61    @GetMapping(path = "/instruments/{instrumentId}/quote", version = "2")
  62    public ResponseEntity<EntityModel<Quote>> quote(@PathVariable String instrumentId,
  63            WebRequest request) {
  64        Instrument instrument = market.instrument(instrumentId);
  65        MarketData.Tick tick = market.tick(instrumentId);
  66        return quoteResponse(instrument, tick, Quote.of(instrument, tick), request);
  67    }
  68
  69    /**
  70     * Quotes change every second, so they may be cached only briefly and only privately
  71     * (market data is licensed per user). The ETag lets a client poll cheaply: an unchanged
  72     * quote costs a 304 with no body.
  73     */
  74    private <T> ResponseEntity<EntityModel<T>> quoteResponse(Instrument instrument, MarketData.Tick tick,
  75            T quote, WebRequest request) {
  76        String etag = "\"q" + tick.sequence() + "\"";
  77        if (request.checkNotModified(etag)) {
  78            return null;
  79        }
  80        EntityModel<T> model = EntityModel.of(quote,
  81                linkTo(methodOn(InstrumentController.class).quote(instrument.id(), null)).withSelfRel(),
  82                linkTo(methodOn(InstrumentController.class).instrument(instrument.id()))
  83                        .withRel("instrument"));
  84        return ResponseEntity.ok()
  85                .cacheControl(CacheControl.maxAge(1, TimeUnit.SECONDS).cachePrivate())
  86                .eTag(etag)
  87                .body(model);
  88    }
  89
  90    /**
  91     * The option chain for one expiration. Every available expiration is offered as a
  92     * link with the same relation, told apart by its "name": the client picks one instead
  93     * of guessing dates.
  94     */
  95    @GetMapping("/instruments/{instrumentId}/option-chain")
  96    public CollectionModel<EntityModel<Instrument>> optionChain(@PathVariable String instrumentId,
  97            @RequestParam(required = false) @DateTimeFormat(iso = DateTimeFormat.ISO.DATE)
  98            LocalDate expiration) {
  99        Instrument underlying = market.instrument(instrumentId);
 100        List<LocalDate> expirations = market.expirations(underlying.id());
 101        LocalDate chosen = expiration != null ? expiration
 102                : expirations.isEmpty() ? null : expirations.getFirst();
 103        List<EntityModel<Instrument>> contracts = chosen == null ? List.of()
 104                : market.optionChain(underlying.id(), chosen).stream().map(this::toModel).toList();
 105
 106        CollectionModel<EntityModel<Instrument>> chain = CollectionModel.of(contracts,
 107                linkTo(methodOn(InstrumentController.class).optionChain(underlying.id(), chosen))
 108                        .withSelfRel(),
 109                linkTo(methodOn(InstrumentController.class).instrument(underlying.id()))
 110                        .withRel("underlying"));
 111        for (LocalDate date : expirations) {
 112            chain.add(linkTo(methodOn(InstrumentController.class).optionChain(underlying.id(), date))
 113                    .withRel("expiration").withName(date.toString()));
 114        }
 115        return chain;
 116    }
 117
 118    private EntityModel<Instrument> toModel(Instrument instrument) {
 119        EntityModel<Instrument> model = EntityModel.of(instrument,
 120                linkTo(methodOn(InstrumentController.class).instrument(instrument.id())).withSelfRel(),
 121                linkTo(methodOn(InstrumentController.class).quote(instrument.id(), null))
 122                        .withRel("quote"));
 123        if (instrument.isOption()) {
 124            String underlyingId = instrument.option().underlyingId();
 125            model.add(linkTo(methodOn(InstrumentController.class).instrument(underlyingId))
 126                    .withRel("underlying"));
 127        } else if (!market.expirations(instrument.id()).isEmpty()) {
 128            model.add(linkTo(methodOn(InstrumentController.class).optionChain(instrument.id(), null))
 129                    .withRel("option-chain"));
 130        }
 131        return model;
 132    }
 133}

   2
   3import java.math.BigDecimal;
   4import java.math.RoundingMode;
   5import java.time.Clock;
   6import java.time.DayOfWeek;
   7import java.time.Instant;
   8import java.time.LocalDate;
   9import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter;
  10import java.time.temporal.ChronoUnit;
  11import java.time.temporal.TemporalAdjusters;
  12import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
  13import java.util.List;
  14import java.util.Locale;
  15import java.util.Map;
  16import java.util.Random;
  17import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
  18
  19import com.example.brokerage.api.market.Instrument.OptionTerms;
  20import com.example.brokerage.api.market.Instrument.Right;
  21import com.example.brokerage.api.market.Instrument.Type;
  22import com.example.brokerage.api.platform.ApiException;
  23
  24import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
  25
  26/**
  27 * The instrument catalog and a simulated market. Prices are fictional: each stock takes a
  28 * small random step every tick, and option prices follow their underlying. Option
  29 * expirations are the third Friday of the next two months, so the demo never serves
  30 * contracts that have already expired.
  31 */
  32@Component
  33public class MarketData {
  34
  35    /** The market state of one instrument at one moment. */
  36    public record Tick(BigDecimal last, BigDecimal bid, BigDecimal ask, BigDecimal bidSize,
  37            BigDecimal askSize, BigDecimal previousClose, long volume, long sequence, Instant asOf) {
  38    }
  39
  40    private static final DateTimeFormatter OPTION_DATE = DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("yyMMdd", Locale.US);
  41    private static final BigDecimal CENT = new BigDecimal("0.01");
  42
  43    private final Map<String, Instrument> instruments = new LinkedHashMap<>();
  44    private final Map<String, Tick> ticks = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
  45    private final Random random = new Random(7);
  46    private final Clock clock;
  47
  48    public MarketData(Clock clock) {
  49        this.clock = clock;
  50        stock("EQ-AAPL", "AAPL", "Apple Inc.", Type.EQUITY, "XNAS", "232.40", "230.10", true);
  51        stock("EQ-MSFT", "MSFT", "Microsoft Corporation", Type.EQUITY, "XNAS", "512.75", "509.90", true);
  52        stock("EQ-NVDA", "NVDA", "NVIDIA Corporation", Type.EQUITY, "XNAS", "186.20", "188.45", true);
  53        stock("EQ-AMZN", "AMZN", "Amazon.com, Inc.", Type.EQUITY, "XNAS", "228.30", "226.00", true);
  54        stock("ETF-SPY", "SPY", "SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust", Type.ETF, "ARCX", "668.10", "664.80", true);
  55        stock("EQ-HALT", "HALT", "Halted Holdings (suspended)", Type.EQUITY, "XNYS", "12.00", "12.00", false);
  56
  57        LocalDate today = LocalDate.now(clock);
  58        for (int monthsAhead = 1; monthsAhead <= 2; monthsAhead++) {
  59            LocalDate expiration = today.plusMonths(monthsAhead).withDayOfMonth(1)
  60                    .with(TemporalAdjusters.dayOfWeekInMonth(3, DayOfWeek.FRIDAY));
  61            for (int strike : new int[] { 220, 230, 240 }) {
  62                option(instruments.get("EQ-AAPL"), expiration, Right.CALL, strike);
  63                option(instruments.get("EQ-AAPL"), expiration, Right.PUT, strike);
  64            }
  65        }
  66    }
  67
  68    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- catalog
  69
  70    public Instrument instrument(String id) {
  71        Instrument instrument = instruments.get(id);
  72        if (instrument == null) {
  73            throw ApiException.notFound("Instrument", id);
  74        }
  75        return instrument;
  76    }
  77
  78    public List<Instrument> search(String symbol, Type type) {
  79        return instruments.values().stream()
  80                .filter(i -> symbol == null || i.symbol().equalsIgnoreCase(symbol))
  81                .filter(i -> type == null || i.type() == type)
  82                .toList();
  83    }
  84
  85    public List<LocalDate> expirations(String underlyingId) {
  86        return options(underlyingId).stream()
  87                .map(i -> i.option().expiration())
  88                .distinct().sorted().toList();
  89    }
  90
  91    public List<Instrument> optionChain(String underlyingId, LocalDate expiration) {
  92        return options(underlyingId).stream()
  93                .filter(i -> i.option().expiration().equals(expiration))
  94                .toList();
  95    }
  96
  97    private List<Instrument> options(String underlyingId) {
  98        return instruments.values().stream()
  99                .filter(i -> i.isOption() && i.option().underlyingId().equals(underlyingId))
 100                .toList();
 101    }
 102
 103    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- prices
 104
 105    public Tick tick(String instrumentId) {
 106        return ticks.get(instrument(instrumentId).id());
 107    }
 108
 109    /** One step of the simulated market. Called on a schedule by the order matcher. */
 110    public synchronized void move() {
 111        for (Instrument instrument : instruments.values()) {
 112            if (instrument.isOption() || !instrument.tradable()) {
 113                continue;
 114            }
 115            Tick tick = ticks.get(instrument.id());
 116            double step = (random.nextGaussian() * 0.0008) * tick.last().doubleValue();
 117            BigDecimal last = tick.last().add(BigDecimal.valueOf(step))
 118                    .setScale(2, RoundingMode.HALF_EVEN);
 119            long volume = tick.volume() + random.nextInt(400);
 120            ticks.put(instrument.id(), stockTick(last, tick.previousClose(), volume, tick.sequence() + 1));
 121        }
 122        instruments.values().stream().filter(Instrument::isOption).forEach(this::priceOption);
 123    }
 124
 125    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- seeding
 126
 127    private void stock(String id, String symbol, String name, Type type, String exchange,
 128            String last, String previousClose, boolean tradable) {
 129        instruments.put(id, new Instrument(id, symbol, name, type, exchange, "USD", tradable, tradable,
 130                BigDecimal.ONE, null));
 131        ticks.put(id, stockTick(new BigDecimal(last), new BigDecimal(previousClose), 1_250_000, 1));
 132    }
 133
 134    private void option(Instrument underlying, LocalDate expiration, Right right, int strike) {
 135        String callOrPut = right == Right.CALL ? "C" : "P";
 136        String id = "OPT-%s-%s-%s-%d".formatted(underlying.symbol(), expiration.format(OPTION_DATE),
 137                callOrPut, strike);
 138        // The OCC option symbol: root, expiration (yyMMdd), C or P, and the strike times 1,000.
 139        String symbol = "%s%s%s%08d".formatted(underlying.symbol(), expiration.format(OPTION_DATE),
 140                callOrPut, strike * 1000);
 141        String name = "%s %s $%d %s".formatted(underlying.symbol(), expiration, strike, right);
 142        OptionTerms terms = new OptionTerms(underlying.id(), underlying.symbol(), right,
 143                BigDecimal.valueOf(strike), expiration, "AMERICAN");
 144        instruments.put(id, new Instrument(id, symbol, name, Type.OPTION, "OPRA", "USD",
 145                true, false, BigDecimal.valueOf(100), terms));
 146        priceOption(instruments.get(id));
 147    }
 148
 149    private Tick stockTick(BigDecimal last, BigDecimal previousClose, long volume, long sequence) {
 150        BigDecimal halfSpread = last.multiply(new BigDecimal("0.0001")).max(CENT)
 151                .setScale(2, RoundingMode.HALF_EVEN);
 152        return new Tick(last, last.subtract(halfSpread), last.add(halfSpread), BigDecimal.valueOf(500),
 153                BigDecimal.valueOf(500), previousClose, volume, sequence, clock.instant());
 154    }
 155
 156    /** Intrinsic value plus a simple time value: enough to look plausible, not a pricing model. */
 157    private void priceOption(Instrument option) {
 158        OptionTerms terms = option.option();
 159        BigDecimal underlying = ticks.get(terms.underlyingId()).last();
 160        BigDecimal intrinsic = (terms.right() == Right.CALL
 161                ? underlying.subtract(terms.strike())
 162                : terms.strike().subtract(underlying)).max(BigDecimal.ZERO);
 163        long days = Math.max(1, ChronoUnit.DAYS.between(LocalDate.now(clock), terms.expiration()));
 164        BigDecimal timeValue = underlying.multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(0.012 * Math.sqrt(days / 30.0)));
 165        BigDecimal mid = intrinsic.add(timeValue).setScale(2, RoundingMode.HALF_EVEN);
 166        Tick previous = ticks.get(option.id());
 167        long sequence = previous == null ? 1 : previous.sequence() + 1;
 168        BigDecimal previousClose = previous == null ? mid : previous.previousClose();
 169        BigDecimal nickel = new BigDecimal("0.05");
 170        ticks.put(option.id(), new Tick(mid, mid.subtract(nickel), mid.add(nickel), BigDecimal.valueOf(50),
 171                BigDecimal.valueOf(50), previousClose, 3_400, sequence, clock.instant()));
 172    }
 173}

   1package com.example.brokerage.api.market;
   2
   3import java.math.BigDecimal;
   4import java.math.RoundingMode;
   5import java.time.Instant;
   6
   7import org.springframework.hateoas.server.core.Relation;
   8
   9/**
  10 * The two representations of a quote. Version 2 regroups price and size into bid and ask
  11 * objects and adds the day's change: a breaking change of shape, so it needs a new API
  12 * version rather than a new optional field.
  13 */
  14public final class Quotes {
  15
  16    private Quotes() {
  17    }
  18
  19    /** API version 1 (deprecated): flat fields. */
  20    @Relation(itemRelation = "quote")
  21    public record QuoteV1(String instrumentId, String symbol, BigDecimal last, BigDecimal bid,
  22            BigDecimal ask, BigDecimal bidSize, BigDecimal askSize, long volume, Instant asOf) {
  23
  24        public static QuoteV1 of(Instrument instrument, MarketData.Tick tick) {
  25            return new QuoteV1(instrument.id(), instrument.symbol(), tick.last(), tick.bid(), tick.ask(),
  26                    tick.bidSize(), tick.askSize(), tick.volume(), tick.asOf());
  27        }
  28    }
  29
  30    /** API version 2: bid and ask as price levels, plus the change since the previous close. */
  31    @Relation(itemRelation = "quote")
  32    public record Quote(String instrumentId, String symbol, BigDecimal last, PriceLevel bid, PriceLevel ask,
  33            BigDecimal change, BigDecimal changePercent, long volume, Instant asOf) {
  34
  35        public record PriceLevel(BigDecimal price, BigDecimal size) {
  36        }
  37
  38        public static Quote of(Instrument instrument, MarketData.Tick tick) {
  39            BigDecimal change = tick.last().subtract(tick.previousClose());
  40            BigDecimal percent = change.multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(100))
  41                    .divide(tick.previousClose(), 2, RoundingMode.HALF_EVEN);
  42            return new Quote(instrument.id(), instrument.symbol(), tick.last(),
  43                    new PriceLevel(tick.bid(), tick.bidSize()), new PriceLevel(tick.ask(), tick.askSize()),
  44                    change, percent, tick.volume(), tick.asOf());
  45        }
  46    }
  47}

   1package com.example.brokerage.api.accounts;
   2
   3import static org.springframework.hateoas.server.mvc.WebMvcLinkBuilder.afford;
   4import static org.springframework.hateoas.server.mvc.WebMvcLinkBuilder.linkTo;
   5import static org.springframework.hateoas.server.mvc.WebMvcLinkBuilder.methodOn;
   6
   7import java.time.LocalDate;
   8import java.time.ZoneOffset;
   9import java.util.List;
  10
  11import com.example.brokerage.api.accounts.Holdings.Balances;
  12import com.example.brokerage.api.accounts.Holdings.Position;
  13import com.example.brokerage.api.market.InstrumentController;
  14import com.example.brokerage.api.orders.OrderController;
  15import com.example.brokerage.api.orders.OrderEventController;
  16import com.example.brokerage.api.platform.Caller;
  17import com.example.brokerage.api.platform.CursorPage;
  18
  19import org.springframework.format.annotation.DateTimeFormat;
  20import org.springframework.hateoas.CollectionModel;
  21import org.springframework.hateoas.EntityModel;
  22import org.springframework.hateoas.Link;
  23import org.springframework.security.core.annotation.AuthenticationPrincipal;
  24import org.springframework.security.oauth2.jwt.Jwt;
  25import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.GetMapping;
  26import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PathVariable;
  27import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestParam;
  28import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController;
  29
  30/**
  31 * Accounts and everything read-only beneath them. Scope: accounts:read.
  32 */
  33@RestController
  34public class AccountController {
  35
  36    private final Ledger ledger;
  37    private final Portfolio portfolio;
  38
  39    public AccountController(Ledger ledger, Portfolio portfolio) {
  40        this.ledger = ledger;
  41        this.portfolio = portfolio;
  42    }
  43
  44    @GetMapping("/accounts")
  45    public CollectionModel<EntityModel<Account>> accounts(@AuthenticationPrincipal Jwt jwt) {
  46        Caller caller = Caller.of(jwt);
  47        List<EntityModel<Account>> accounts = ledger.accounts(caller.customerId()).stream()
  48                .map(account -> toModel(account, caller))
  49                .toList();
  50        return CollectionModel.of(accounts,
  51                linkTo(methodOn(AccountController.class).accounts(null)).withSelfRel());
  52    }
  53
  54    @GetMapping("/accounts/{accountId}")
  55    public EntityModel<Account> account(@PathVariable String accountId,
  56            @AuthenticationPrincipal Jwt jwt) {
  57        Caller caller = Caller.of(jwt);
  58        return toModel(ledger.account(caller.customerId(), accountId), caller);
  59    }
  60
  61    @GetMapping("/accounts/{accountId}/balances")
  62    public EntityModel<Balances> balances(@PathVariable String accountId,
  63            @AuthenticationPrincipal Jwt jwt) {
  64        Account account = ledger.account(Caller.of(jwt).customerId(), accountId);
  65        return EntityModel.of(portfolio.balances(account),
  66                linkTo(methodOn(AccountController.class).balances(accountId, null)).withSelfRel(),
  67                linkTo(methodOn(AccountController.class).account(accountId, null)).withRel("account"),
  68                linkTo(methodOn(AccountController.class).positions(accountId, null)).withRel("positions"));
  69    }
  70
  71    @GetMapping("/accounts/{accountId}/positions")
  72    public CollectionModel<EntityModel<Position>> positions(@PathVariable String accountId,
  73            @AuthenticationPrincipal Jwt jwt) {
  74        Account account = ledger.account(Caller.of(jwt).customerId(), accountId);
  75        List<EntityModel<Position>> positions = portfolio.positions(account).stream()
  76                .map(position -> toModel(accountId, position))
  77                .toList();
  78        return CollectionModel.of(positions,
  79                linkTo(methodOn(AccountController.class).positions(accountId, null)).withSelfRel(),
  80                linkTo(methodOn(AccountController.class).account(accountId, null)).withRel("account"));
  81    }
  82
  83    @GetMapping("/accounts/{accountId}/positions/{instrumentId}")
  84    public EntityModel<Position> position(@PathVariable String accountId,
  85            @PathVariable String instrumentId, @AuthenticationPrincipal Jwt jwt) {
  86        Account account = ledger.account(Caller.of(jwt).customerId(), accountId);
  87        return toModel(accountId, portfolio.position(account, instrumentId));
  88    }
  89
  90    /**
  91     * Transaction history, newest first, filterable by type and by an inclusive date range
  92     * (UTC), paged with an opaque cursor.
  93     */
  94    @GetMapping("/accounts/{accountId}/transactions")
  95    public CollectionModel<EntityModel<Transaction>> transactions(@PathVariable String accountId,
  96            @RequestParam(required = false) Transaction.Type type,
  97            @RequestParam(required = false) @DateTimeFormat(iso = DateTimeFormat.ISO.DATE) LocalDate from,
  98            @RequestParam(required = false) @DateTimeFormat(iso = DateTimeFormat.ISO.DATE) LocalDate to,
  99            @RequestParam(required = false) String cursor, @RequestParam(required = false) Integer limit,
 100            @AuthenticationPrincipal Jwt jwt) {
 101        Account account = ledger.account(Caller.of(jwt).customerId(), accountId);
 102        List<Transaction> matching = ledger.transactions(account.id()).stream()
 103                .filter(t -> type == null || t.type() == type)
 104                .filter(t -> from == null || !utcDate(t).isBefore(from))
 105                .filter(t -> to == null || !utcDate(t).isAfter(to))
 106                .toList();
 107        CursorPage<Transaction> page = CursorPage.of(matching, Transaction::occurredAt, Transaction::id,
 108                cursor, limit);
 109
 110        CollectionModel<EntityModel<Transaction>> model = CollectionModel.of(
 111                page.items().stream().map(EntityModel::of).toList(),
 112                linkTo(methodOn(AccountController.class)
 113                        .transactions(accountId, type, from, to, cursor, limit, null))
 114                        .withSelfRel().expand(),
 115                linkTo(methodOn(AccountController.class).account(accountId, null)).withRel("account"));
 116        if (page.hasNext()) {
 117            // expand(): "next" is a concrete URL, not a template with the unused filters left open
 118            model.add(linkTo(methodOn(AccountController.class)
 119                    .transactions(accountId, type, from, to, page.nextCursor(), limit, null))
 120                    .withRel("next").expand());
 121        }
 122        return model;
 123    }
 124
 125    private static LocalDate utcDate(Transaction transaction) {
 126        return transaction.occurredAt().atZone(ZoneOffset.UTC).toLocalDate();
 127    }
 128
 129    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- representations
 130
 131    /**
 132     * An account's links depend on what the caller may do: a token without orders:read is
 133     * not shown the orders at all, and only a token with orders:write is offered the
 134     * "placeOrder" affordance. Clients discover their capabilities instead of hard-coding them.
 135     */
 136    EntityModel<Account> toModel(Account account, Caller caller) {
 137        String id = account.id();
 138        EntityModel<Account> model = EntityModel.of(account,
 139                linkTo(methodOn(AccountController.class).account(id, null)).withSelfRel(),
 140                linkTo(methodOn(AccountController.class).balances(id, null)).withRel("balances"),
 141                linkTo(methodOn(AccountController.class).positions(id, null)).withRel("positions"),
 142                linkTo(methodOn(AccountController.class).transactions(id, null, null, null, null, null, null))
 143                        .withRel("transactions"));
 144        if (caller.canReadOrders()) {
 145            Link orders = linkTo(methodOn(OrderController.class).orders(id, null, null, null, null, null))
 146                    .withRel("orders");
 147            if (caller.canTrade()) {
 148                orders = orders.andAffordance(
 149                        afford(methodOn(OrderController.class).placeOrder(id, null, null, null)));
 150            }
 151            model.add(orders,
 152                    linkTo(methodOn(OrderController.class).previewOrder(id, null, null))
 153                            .withRel("order-previews"),
 154                    linkTo(methodOn(OrderEventController.class).events(id, null, null))
 155                            .withRel("order-events"));
 156        }
 157        return model;
 158    }
 159
 160    private EntityModel<Position> toModel(String accountId, Position position) {
 161        return EntityModel.of(position,
 162                linkTo(methodOn(AccountController.class).position(accountId, position.instrumentId(), null))
 163                        .withSelfRel(),
 164                linkTo(methodOn(InstrumentController.class).instrument(position.instrumentId()))
 165                        .withRel("instrument"),
 166                linkTo(methodOn(InstrumentController.class).quote(position.instrumentId(), null))
 167                        .withRel("quote"));
 168    }
 169}

  10/**
  11 * The read models derived from the ledger and the market: positions and balances.
  12 */
  13public final class Holdings {
  14
  15    private Holdings() {
  16    }
  17
  18    /**
  19     * A holding valued at the current market price.
  20     *
  21     * @param averageCost per share, or per contract share for options
  22     */
  23    @Relation(collectionRelation = "positions", itemRelation = "position")
  24    public record Position(String instrumentId, String symbol, Instrument.Type instrumentType,
  25            BigDecimal quantity, BigDecimal averageCost, BigDecimal costBasis, BigDecimal lastPrice,
  26            BigDecimal marketValue, BigDecimal unrealizedPnl, BigDecimal unrealizedPnlPercent) {
  27    }
  28
  29    /**
  30     * What the account is worth and what it can buy.
  31     *
  32     * @param reservedForOrders cash held back for open buy orders that have not filled yet
  33     */
  34    public record Balances(String accountId, String currency, BigDecimal cash, BigDecimal reservedForOrders,
  35            BigDecimal buyingPower, BigDecimal positionsMarketValue, BigDecimal totalEquity,
  36            BigDecimal unrealizedPnl, Instant asOf) {
  37    }
  38
  39    /**
  40     * Buying power: unreserved cash in a cash account, twice that in a margin account
  41     * (the 50% initial margin of Regulation T). A deliberate simplification.
  42     */
  43    public static BigDecimal buyingPower(Account.Type type, BigDecimal cash, BigDecimal reserved) {
  44        BigDecimal free = cash.subtract(reserved).max(BigDecimal.ZERO);
  45        return type == Account.Type.MARGIN ? free.multiply(BigDecimal.TWO) : free;
  46    }
  47}

  25
  26/**
  27 * The books of record: accounts, cash, holdings and transaction history, held in memory
  28 * and seeded with two demo customers. Every mutation goes through {@link #recordTrade},
  29 * which keeps cash, holdings and history consistent with one another.
  30 */
  31@Component
  32public class Ledger {
  33
  34    /** One holding: how much, and at what average cost per unit. */
  35    public record Holding(String instrumentId, BigDecimal quantity, BigDecimal averageCost) {
  36    }
  37
  38    private static final class Book {
  39        BigDecimal cash;
  40        final Map<String, Holding> holdings = new LinkedHashMap<>();
  41        final List<Transaction> transactions = new ArrayList<>();
  42
  43        Book(BigDecimal cash) {
  44            this.cash = cash;
  45        }
  46    }
  47
  48    private final Map<String, Account> accounts = new LinkedHashMap<>();
  49    private final Map<String, Book> books = new LinkedHashMap<>();
  50    private final AtomicInteger transactionIds = new AtomicInteger(1000);
  51    private final MarketData market;
  52    private final Clock clock;
  53
  54    public Ledger(MarketData market, Clock clock) {
  55        this.market = market;
  56        this.clock = clock;
  57        seed();
  58    }
  59
  60    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- reads
  61
  62    public List<Account> accounts(String customerId) {
  63        return accounts.values().stream().filter(a -> a.customerId().equals(customerId)).toList();
  64    }
  65
  66    /**
  67     * An account the customer owns. Someone else's account is reported as not found,
  68     * not as forbidden: a 403 would confirm that the account exists.
  69     */
  70    public Account account(String customerId, String accountId) {
  71        Account account = accounts.get(accountId);
  72        if (account == null || !account.customerId().equals(customerId)) {
  73            throw ApiException.notFound("Account", accountId);
  74        }
  75        return account;
  76    }
  77
  78    public synchronized BigDecimal cash(String accountId) {
  79        return books.get(accountId).cash;
  80    }
  81
  82    public synchronized List<Holding> holdings(String accountId) {
  83        return List.copyOf(books.get(accountId).holdings.values());
  84    }
  85
  86    public synchronized BigDecimal quantityHeld(String accountId, String instrumentId) {
  87        Holding holding = books.get(accountId).holdings.get(instrumentId);
  88        return holding == null ? BigDecimal.ZERO : holding.quantity();
  89    }
  90
  91    public synchronized List<Transaction> transactions(String accountId) {
  92        return List.copyOf(books.get(accountId).transactions);
  93    }
  94
  95    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- writes
  96
  97    /**
  98     * Books one execution. A positive quantity is a purchase, a negative one a sale.
  99     * Cash moves by quantity x price x multiplier, plus or minus commission.
 100     */
 101    public synchronized Transaction recordTrade(String accountId, Instrument instrument,
 102            BigDecimal signedQuantity, BigDecimal price, BigDecimal commission, String orderId,
 103            Instant at) {
 104        Book book = books.get(accountId);
 105        BigDecimal quantity = signedQuantity.abs();
 106        BigDecimal gross = quantity.multiply(price).multiply(instrument.multiplier());
 107        boolean buy = signedQuantity.signum() > 0;
 108        BigDecimal cashChange = (buy ? gross.negate() : gross).subtract(commission)
 109                .setScale(2, RoundingMode.HALF_EVEN);
 110        book.cash = book.cash.add(cashChange);
 111
 112        Holding old = book.holdings.get(instrument.id());
 113        BigDecimal oldQuantity = old == null ? BigDecimal.ZERO : old.quantity();
 114        BigDecimal newQuantity = oldQuantity.add(signedQuantity);
 115        if (newQuantity.signum() == 0) {
 116            book.holdings.remove(instrument.id());
 117        } else if (buy) {
 118            BigDecimal oldCost = old == null ? BigDecimal.ZERO
 119                    : old.quantity().multiply(old.averageCost());
 120            BigDecimal averageCost = oldCost.add(quantity.multiply(price))
 121                    .divide(newQuantity, 4, RoundingMode.HALF_EVEN);
 122            book.holdings.put(instrument.id(), new Holding(instrument.id(), newQuantity, averageCost));
 123        } else {
 124            BigDecimal averageCost = old == null ? price : old.averageCost();
 125            book.holdings.put(instrument.id(), new Holding(instrument.id(), newQuantity, averageCost));
 126        }
 127
 128        String what = instrument.symbol() + (instrument.isOption() ? " option" : "");
 129        String description = "%s %s %s @ %s".formatted(buy ? "Bought" : "Sold",
 130                quantity.stripTrailingZeros().toPlainString(), what, price.toPlainString());
 131        Transaction transaction = new Transaction(nextTransactionId(), Type.TRADE, description, cashChange,
 132                instrument.id(), instrument.symbol(), quantity, price, orderId, at, settlementDate(at));
 133        book.transactions.add(transaction);
 134        return transaction;
 135    }
 136
 137    /** US equity and option trades settle one business day after the trade date (T+1). */
 138    private static LocalDate settlementDate(Instant tradeTime) {
 139        LocalDate date = tradeTime.atZone(ZoneOffset.UTC).toLocalDate().plusDays(1);
 140        while (date.getDayOfWeek() == DayOfWeek.SATURDAY || date.getDayOfWeek() == DayOfWeek.SUNDAY) {
 141            date = date.plusDays(1);
 142        }
 143        return date;
 144    }
 145
 146    private String nextTransactionId() {
 147        return "TXN-" + transactionIds.incrementAndGet();
 148    }
 149
 150    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- seed data
 151
 152    private void seed() {
 153        open(new Account("ACC-1001", "cust-1001", "****4821", "Individual Margin", Account.Type.MARGIN,
 154                Registration.INDIVIDUAL, "USD", LocalDate.of(2021, 3, 15)));
 155        open(new Account("ACC-1002", "cust-1001", "****7304", "Roth IRA", Account.Type.CASH,
 156                Registration.ROTH_IRA, "USD", LocalDate.of(2023, 1, 9)));
 157        open(new Account("ACC-2001", "cust-2002", "****5518", "Individual Cash", Account.Type.CASH,
 158                Registration.INDIVIDUAL, "USD", LocalDate.of(2024, 6, 2)));
 159
 160        // Every cash movement is a transaction, so balances reconcile with the history.
 161        deposit("ACC-1001", "50000.00", 400);
 162        deposit("ACC-1001", "10000.00", 120);
 163        historicalBuy("ACC-1001", "EQ-AAPL", "50", "180.25", 360);
 164        historicalBuy("ACC-1001", "EQ-MSFT", "20", "402.10", 300);
 165        historicalBuy("ACC-1001", "ETF-SPY", "15", "540.00", 200);
 166        dividend("ACC-1001", "EQ-AAPL", "13.00", 45);
 167        dividend("ACC-1001", "ETF-SPY", "26.85", 20);
 168        historicalBuy("ACC-1001", "EQ-AMZN", "12", "205.40", 9);
 169
 170        deposit("ACC-1002", "12000.00", 600);
 171        historicalBuy("ACC-1002", "EQ-NVDA", "40", "120.50", 500);
 172        dividend("ACC-1002", "EQ-NVDA", "0.40", 60);
 173
 174        deposit("ACC-2001", "5000.00", 90);
 175        historicalBuy("ACC-2001", "EQ-AMZN", "10", "190.00", 80);
 176        books.values().forEach(book -> book.transactions.sort(Comparator.comparing(Transaction::occurredAt)));
 177    }
 178
 179    private void open(Account account) {
 180        accounts.put(account.id(), account);
 181        books.put(account.id(), new Book(BigDecimal.ZERO));
 182    }
 183
 184    private Instant daysAgo(int days) {
 185        return clock.instant().minus(Duration.ofDays(days)).minus(Duration.ofMinutes(days * 7L % 300));
 186    }
 187
 188    private void deposit(String accountId, String amount, int daysAgo) {
 189        Book book = books.get(accountId);
 190        BigDecimal cash = new BigDecimal(amount);
 191        book.cash = book.cash.add(cash);
 192        Instant at = daysAgo(daysAgo);
 193        book.transactions.add(new Transaction(nextTransactionId(), Type.DEPOSIT, "ACH deposit",
 194                cash, null, null, null, null, null, at, settlementDate(at)));
 195    }
 196
 197    private void dividend(String accountId, String instrumentId, String amount, int daysAgo) {
 198        Instrument instrument = market.instrument(instrumentId);
 199        Book book = books.get(accountId);
 200        BigDecimal cash = new BigDecimal(amount);
 201        book.cash = book.cash.add(cash);
 202        Instant at = daysAgo(daysAgo);
 203        LocalDate paid = at.atZone(ZoneOffset.UTC).toLocalDate(); // a dividend settles when it is paid
 204        book.transactions.add(new Transaction(nextTransactionId(), Type.DIVIDEND,
 205                "Cash dividend " + instrument.symbol(), cash, instrument.id(), instrument.symbol(),
 206                null, null, null, at, paid));
 207    }
 208
 209    private void historicalBuy(String accountId, String instrumentId, String quantity, String price,
 210            int daysAgo) {
 211        recordTrade(accountId, market.instrument(instrumentId), new BigDecimal(quantity),
 212                new BigDecimal(price), BigDecimal.ZERO, null, daysAgo(daysAgo));
 213    }
 214}

   1package com.example.brokerage.api.accounts;
   2
   3import java.math.BigDecimal;
   4import java.math.RoundingMode;
   5import java.time.Clock;
   6import java.util.List;
   7
   8import com.example.brokerage.api.accounts.Holdings.Balances;
   9import com.example.brokerage.api.accounts.Holdings.Position;
  10import com.example.brokerage.api.market.Instrument;
  11import com.example.brokerage.api.market.MarketData;
  12import com.example.brokerage.api.platform.ApiException;
  13
  14import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
  15
  16/**
  17 * Values the ledger at current market prices: positions and balances are computed on
  18 * every request, never stored, so they can never drift from the books of record.
  19 */
  20@Service
  21public class Portfolio {
  22
  23    private final Ledger ledger;
  24    private final MarketData market;
  25    private final Reservations reservations;
  26    private final Clock clock;
  27
  28    public Portfolio(Ledger ledger, MarketData market, Reservations reservations, Clock clock) {
  29        this.ledger = ledger;
  30        this.market = market;
  31        this.reservations = reservations;
  32        this.clock = clock;
  33    }
  34
  35    public List<Position> positions(Account account) {
  36        return ledger.holdings(account.id()).stream().map(this::value).toList();
  37    }
  38
  39    public Position position(Account account, String instrumentId) {
  40        return ledger.holdings(account.id()).stream()
  41                .filter(h -> h.instrumentId().equals(instrumentId))
  42                .findFirst()
  43                .map(this::value)
  44                .orElseThrow(() -> ApiException.notFound("Position", instrumentId));
  45    }
  46
  47    public Balances balances(Account account) {
  48        List<Position> positions = positions(account);
  49        BigDecimal cash = ledger.cash(account.id());
  50        BigDecimal reserved = reservations.reservedCash(account.id());
  51        BigDecimal marketValue = positions.stream().map(Position::marketValue)
  52                .reduce(BigDecimal.ZERO, BigDecimal::add);
  53        BigDecimal unrealized = positions.stream().map(Position::unrealizedPnl)
  54                .reduce(BigDecimal.ZERO, BigDecimal::add);
  55        return new Balances(account.id(), account.currency(), cash, reserved,
  56                Holdings.buyingPower(account.type(), cash, reserved), marketValue, cash.add(marketValue),
  57                unrealized, clock.instant());
  58    }
  59
  60    private Position value(Ledger.Holding holding) {
  61        Instrument instrument = market.instrument(holding.instrumentId());
  62        BigDecimal last = market.tick(instrument.id()).last();
  63        BigDecimal multiplier = instrument.multiplier();
  64        BigDecimal costBasis = money(holding.quantity().multiply(holding.averageCost()).multiply(multiplier));
  65        BigDecimal marketValue = money(holding.quantity().multiply(last).multiply(multiplier));
  66        BigDecimal pnl = marketValue.subtract(costBasis);
  67        BigDecimal pnlPercent = costBasis.signum() == 0 ? BigDecimal.ZERO
  68                : pnl.multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(100)).divide(costBasis, 2, RoundingMode.HALF_EVEN);
  69        return new Position(instrument.id(), instrument.symbol(), instrument.type(), holding.quantity(),
  70                holding.averageCost().setScale(2, RoundingMode.HALF_EVEN), costBasis, last, marketValue, pnl,
  71                pnlPercent);
  72    }
  73
  74    private static BigDecimal money(BigDecimal amount) {
  75        return amount.setScale(2, RoundingMode.HALF_EVEN);
  76    }
  77}

   1package com.example.brokerage.api.orders;
   2
   3import java.time.Clock;
   4import java.time.Duration;
   5import java.time.Instant;
   6import java.util.Map;
   7import java.util.Optional;
   8import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
   9
  10import com.example.brokerage.api.platform.ApiException;
  11import com.example.brokerage.api.platform.ProblemType;
  12
  13import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
  14
  15/**
  16 * Remembers which order each Idempotency-Key created, for 24 hours.
  17 *
  18 * <p>A network timeout leaves a client unsure whether its order was placed. With a key,
  19 * retrying is always safe: the same key and the same request return the original order
  20 * instead of buying twice. The same key with a different request is a client bug, and is
  21 * refused rather than guessed at.
  22 */
  23@Component
  24public class IdempotencyKeys {
  25
  26    static final Duration RETENTION = Duration.ofHours(24);
  27
  28    private record Entry(String fingerprint, String orderId, Instant createdAt) {
  29    }
  30
  31    private final Map<String, Entry> entries = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
  32    private final Clock clock;
  33
  34    public IdempotencyKeys(Clock clock) {
  35        this.clock = clock;
  36    }
  37
  38    /** The order already created with this key, if any. */
  39    Optional<String> existingOrder(String scope, String key, String fingerprint) {
  40        Instant now = clock.instant();
  41        entries.values().removeIf(entry -> entry.createdAt().plus(RETENTION).isBefore(now));
  42        Entry entry = entries.get(scope + "|" + key);
  43        if (entry == null) {
  44            return Optional.empty();
  45        }
  46        if (!entry.fingerprint().equals(fingerprint)) {
  47            throw new ApiException(ProblemType.IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED,
  48                    "Idempotency-Key " + key + " was already used for a different order request");
  49        }
  50        return Optional.of(entry.orderId());
  51    }
  52
  53    void remember(String scope, String key, String fingerprint, String orderId) {
  54        entries.put(scope + "|" + key, new Entry(fingerprint, orderId, clock.instant()));
  55    }
  56}

   1package com.example.brokerage.api.orders;
   2
   3import java.math.BigDecimal;
   4import java.math.RoundingMode;
   5import java.time.Instant;
   6import java.util.ArrayList;
   7import java.util.List;
   8
   9import com.example.brokerage.api.market.Instrument;
  10import com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonIgnore;
  11import com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonProperty;
  12
  13import org.springframework.hateoas.server.core.Relation;
  14
  15/**
  16 * An order and its lifecycle. Orders are never deleted: a canceled or filled order stays
  17 * readable, which is why canceling is a state change (POST .../cancellation), not DELETE.
  18 *
  19 * <pre>
  20 *   OPEN ──fill──▶ PARTIALLY_FILLED ──fill──▶ FILLED
  21 *    │                    │
  22 *    └──cancel──▶ PENDING_CANCEL ◀──cancel──┘ ──▶ CANCELLED
  23 * </pre>
  24 *
  25 * @param version incremented on every change; exposed only as the ETag header
  26 */
  27@Relation(collectionRelation = "orders", itemRelation = "order")
  28public record Order(String id, String accountId, String clientOrderId, String instrumentId, String symbol,
  29        Instrument.Type instrumentType, Side side, Type type, TimeInForce timeInForce, BigDecimal quantity,
  30        BigDecimal limitPrice, BigDecimal stopPrice, Status status, BigDecimal filledQuantity,
  31        BigDecimal averageFillPrice, List<Fill> fills, Instant createdAt, Instant updatedAt,
  32        @JsonIgnore boolean stopTriggered, @JsonIgnore long version) {
  33
  34    public enum Side { BUY, SELL }
  35
  36    public enum Type { MARKET, LIMIT, STOP, STOP_LIMIT }
  37
  38    /** DAY orders expire at the close; GTC ("good 'til canceled") orders stay working. */
  39    public enum TimeInForce { DAY, GTC }
  40
  41    public enum Status {
  42        OPEN, PARTIALLY_FILLED, FILLED, PENDING_CANCEL, CANCELLED, REJECTED;
  43
  44        /** Can still fill, and so can still be changed or canceled. */
  45        public boolean isWorking() {
  46            return this == OPEN || this == PARTIALLY_FILLED;
  47        }
  48
  49        /** Not yet in a final state. */
  50        public boolean isOpen() {
  51            return isWorking() || this == PENDING_CANCEL;
  52        }
  53    }
  54
  55    /** One execution against the order. */
  56    public record Fill(String id, BigDecimal quantity, BigDecimal price, Instant executedAt) {
  57    }
  58
  59    @JsonProperty
  60    public BigDecimal remainingQuantity() {
  61        return quantity.subtract(filledQuantity);
  62    }
  63
  64    /** A strong entity tag: changes whenever the order changes. */
  65    @JsonIgnore
  66    public String etag() {
  67        return "\"" + id + "-v" + version + "\"";
  68    }
  69
  70    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- state changes
  71
  72    Order withStatus(Status newStatus, Instant at) {
  73        return new Order(id, accountId, clientOrderId, instrumentId, symbol, instrumentType, side, type,
  74                timeInForce, quantity, limitPrice, stopPrice, newStatus, filledQuantity,
  75                averageFillPrice, fills, createdAt, at, stopTriggered, version + 1);
  76    }
  77
  78    Order withStopTriggered() {
  79        return new Order(id, accountId, clientOrderId, instrumentId, symbol, instrumentType, side, type,
  80                timeInForce, quantity, limitPrice, stopPrice, status, filledQuantity, averageFillPrice, fills,
  81                createdAt, updatedAt, true, version);
  82    }
  83
  84    Order withFill(Fill fill) {
  85        BigDecimal filled = filledQuantity.add(fill.quantity());
  86        BigDecimal cost = averageFillPrice == null ? BigDecimal.ZERO
  87                : averageFillPrice.multiply(filledQuantity);
  88        BigDecimal average = cost.add(fill.price().multiply(fill.quantity()))
  89                .divide(filled, 4, RoundingMode.HALF_EVEN);
  90        List<Fill> allFills = new ArrayList<>(fills);
  91        allFills.add(fill);
  92        Status newStatus = filled.compareTo(quantity) == 0 ? Status.FILLED
  93                : status == Status.PENDING_CANCEL ? Status.PENDING_CANCEL : Status.PARTIALLY_FILLED;
  94        return new Order(id, accountId, clientOrderId, instrumentId, symbol, instrumentType, side, type,
  95                timeInForce, quantity, limitPrice, stopPrice, newStatus, filled, average,
  96                List.copyOf(allFills), createdAt, fill.executedAt(), stopTriggered, version + 1);
  97    }
  98
  99    Order withTerms(BigDecimal newQuantity, BigDecimal newLimit, BigDecimal newStop, TimeInForce newTif,
 100            Instant at) {
 101        return new Order(id, accountId, clientOrderId, instrumentId, symbol, instrumentType, side, type,
 102                newTif, newQuantity, newLimit, newStop, status, filledQuantity, averageFillPrice, fills,
 103                createdAt, at, stopTriggered, version + 1);
 104    }
 105}

   3import static org.springframework.hateoas.server.mvc.WebMvcLinkBuilder.linkTo;
   4import static org.springframework.hateoas.server.mvc.WebMvcLinkBuilder.methodOn;

   6import java.util.List;

   8import jakarta.validation.Valid;

  10import com.example.brokerage.api.accounts.AccountController;
  11import com.example.brokerage.api.platform.Caller;
  12import com.example.brokerage.api.platform.CursorPage;
  13
  14import org.springframework.hateoas.CollectionModel;
  15import org.springframework.hateoas.EntityModel;
  16import org.springframework.hateoas.IanaLinkRelations;
  17import org.springframework.http.HttpHeaders;
  18import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
  19import org.springframework.security.core.annotation.AuthenticationPrincipal;
  20import org.springframework.security.oauth2.jwt.Jwt;
  21import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.GetMapping;
  22import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PatchMapping;
  23import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PathVariable;
  24import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PostMapping;
  25import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestBody;
  26import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestHeader;
  27import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestParam;
  28import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController;
  29import org.springframework.web.context.request.WebRequest;
  30
  31/**
  32 * Orders. Reading needs orders:read; placing, changing and canceling need orders:write.
  33 */
  34@RestController
  35public class OrderController {
  36
  37    public static final String IDEMPOTENCY_KEY = "Idempotency-Key";
  38    public static final String MERGE_PATCH_JSON = "application/merge-patch+json";
  39
  40    private final OrderService service;
  41    private final OrderModelAssembler assembler;
  42
  43    public OrderController(OrderService service, OrderModelAssembler assembler) {
  44        this.service = service;
  45        this.assembler = assembler;
  46    }
  47
  48    /** Orders, newest first, optionally filtered by status (repeatable) and symbol. */
  49    @GetMapping("/accounts/{accountId}/orders")
  50    public CollectionModel<EntityModel<Order>> orders(@PathVariable String accountId,
  51            @RequestParam(required = false) List<Order.Status> status,
  52            @RequestParam(required = false) String symbol,
  53            @RequestParam(required = false) String cursor, @RequestParam(required = false) Integer limit,
  54            @AuthenticationPrincipal Jwt jwt) {
  55        Caller caller = Caller.of(jwt);
  56        CursorPage<Order> page = service.orders(caller, accountId, status, symbol, cursor, limit);
  57        CollectionModel<EntityModel<Order>> model = CollectionModel.of(
  58                page.items().stream().map(order -> assembler.toModel(order, caller)).toList(),
  59                linkTo(methodOn(OrderController.class).orders(accountId, status, symbol, cursor, limit, null))
  60                        .withSelfRel().expand(),
  61                linkTo(methodOn(AccountController.class).account(accountId, null)).withRel("account"));
  62        if (page.hasNext()) {
  63            model.add(linkTo(methodOn(OrderController.class)
  64                    .orders(accountId, status, symbol, page.nextCursor(), limit, null))
  65                    .withRel(IanaLinkRelations.NEXT).expand());
  66        }
  67        return model;
  68    }
  69
  70    /**
  71     * Places an order: 201 Created with a Location header and the order's ETag. Retrying
  72     * with the same Idempotency-Key returns the original order, marked Idempotent-Replayed.
  73     */
  74    @PostMapping("/accounts/{accountId}/orders")
  75    public ResponseEntity<EntityModel<Order>> placeOrder(@PathVariable String accountId,
  76            @RequestHeader(name = IDEMPOTENCY_KEY, required = false) String idempotencyKey,
  77            @Valid @RequestBody OrderRequest request, @AuthenticationPrincipal Jwt jwt) {
  78        Caller caller = Caller.of(jwt);
  79        OrderService.Placement placement = service.place(caller, accountId, request, idempotencyKey);
  80        EntityModel<Order> model = assembler.toModel(placement.order(), caller);
  81        return ResponseEntity.created(model.getRequiredLink(IanaLinkRelations.SELF).toUri())
  82                .eTag(placement.order().etag())
  83                .header("Idempotent-Replayed", Boolean.toString(placement.replayed()))
  84                .body(model);
  85    }
  86
  87    /** One order. Its ETag supports cheap polling (If-None-Match) and safe edits (If-Match). */
  88    @GetMapping("/accounts/{accountId}/orders/{orderId}")
  89    public ResponseEntity<EntityModel<Order>> order(@PathVariable String accountId,
  90            @PathVariable String orderId, WebRequest request, @AuthenticationPrincipal Jwt jwt) {
  91        Caller caller = Caller.of(jwt);
  92        Order order = service.order(caller, accountId, orderId);
  93        if (request.checkNotModified(order.etag())) {
  94            return null;
  95        }
  96        return ResponseEntity.ok().eTag(order.etag()).body(assembler.toModel(order, caller));
  97    }
  98
  99    /** Changes a working order's quantity, prices or time in force. Requires If-Match. */
 100    @PatchMapping(path = "/accounts/{accountId}/orders/{orderId}",
 101            consumes = { MERGE_PATCH_JSON, "application/json" })
 102    public ResponseEntity<EntityModel<Order>> replaceOrder(@PathVariable String accountId,
 103            @PathVariable String orderId,
 104            @RequestHeader(name = HttpHeaders.IF_MATCH, required = false) String ifMatch,
 105            @Valid @RequestBody OrderAmendment change, @AuthenticationPrincipal Jwt jwt) {
 106        Caller caller = Caller.of(jwt);
 107        Order order = service.amend(caller, accountId, orderId, change, ifMatch);
 108        return ResponseEntity.ok().eTag(order.etag()).body(assembler.toModel(order, caller));
 109    }
 110
 111    /**
 112     * Requests cancellation. 202 Accepted: the cancel is in progress, and the Location
 113     * header points at the order, whose status will become CANCELLED.
 114     */
 115    @PostMapping("/accounts/{accountId}/orders/{orderId}/cancellation")
 116    public ResponseEntity<EntityModel<Order>> cancelOrder(@PathVariable String accountId,
 117            @PathVariable String orderId, @AuthenticationPrincipal Jwt jwt) {
 118        Caller caller = Caller.of(jwt);
 119        Order order = service.cancel(caller, accountId, orderId);
 120        EntityModel<Order> model = assembler.toModel(order, caller);
 121        return ResponseEntity.accepted()
 122                .location(linkTo(methodOn(OrderController.class).order(accountId, orderId, null, null))
 123                        .toUri())
 124                .eTag(order.etag())
 125                .body(model);
 126    }
 127
 128    /**
 129     * Estimates an order without placing it. Safe to call as often as a user edits a
 130     * ticket; when the order would be accepted, a link to place it is included.
 131     */
 132    @PostMapping("/accounts/{accountId}/order-previews")
 133    public EntityModel<OrderPreview> previewOrder(@PathVariable String accountId,
 134            @Valid @RequestBody OrderRequest request, @AuthenticationPrincipal Jwt jwt) {
 135        Caller caller = Caller.of(jwt);
 136        OrderPreview preview = service.preview(caller, accountId, request);
 137        EntityModel<OrderPreview> model = EntityModel.of(preview,
 138                linkTo(methodOn(AccountController.class).account(accountId, null)).withRel("account"));
 139        if (preview.acceptable() && caller.canTrade()) {
 140            // expand(): this link is a POST target, so the listing's query parameters do not apply
 141            model.add(linkTo(methodOn(OrderController.class).orders(accountId, null, null, null, null, null))
 142                    .withRel("place-order").expand());
 143        }
 144        return model;
 145    }
 146}
