   1package com.example.brokerage.api.orders;
   2
   3import java.io.IOException;
   4import java.time.Clock;
   5import java.time.Instant;
   6import java.util.ArrayDeque;
   7import java.util.Deque;
   8import java.util.List;
   9import java.util.Map;
  10import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
  11import java.util.concurrent.CopyOnWriteArrayList;
  12import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicLong;
  13import java.util.function.Function;
  14
  15import org.springframework.http.MediaType;
  16import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
  17import org.springframework.web.servlet.mvc.method.annotation.SseEmitter;
  18
  19/**
  20 * Order lifecycle events, pushed to subscribers as Server-Sent Events.
  21 *
  22 * <p>Every event gets an increasing ID, and the last 500 events of each account are kept.
  23 * A client that loses its connection reconnects with a Last-Event-ID header and receives
  24 * exactly the events it missed: no polling, and no gaps.
  25 */
  26@Component
  27public class OrderEvents {
  28
  29    /** Something happened to an order. The type is order.created, order.filled, etc. */
  30    public record Event(long id, String type, Order order, Instant at) {
  31    }
  32
  33    private record Subscriber(SseEmitter emitter, Function<Event, Object> renderer) {
  34    }
  35
  36    private static final int HISTORY = 500;
  37    private static final long TIMEOUT_MILLIS = 30 * 60 * 1000L;
  38
  39    private final AtomicLong sequence = new AtomicLong();
  40    private final Map<String, Deque<Event>> history = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
  41    private final Map<String, List<Subscriber>> subscribers = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
  42    private final Clock clock;
  43
  44    public OrderEvents(Clock clock) {
  45        this.clock = clock;
  46    }
  47
  48    void publish(String type, Order order) {
  49        Event event = new Event(sequence.incrementAndGet(), type, order, clock.instant());
  50        Deque<Event> events = history.computeIfAbsent(order.accountId(), id -> new ArrayDeque<>());
  51        synchronized (events) {
  52            events.addLast(event);
  53            if (events.size() > HISTORY) {
  54                events.removeFirst();
  55            }
  56        }
  57        for (Subscriber subscriber : subscribers.getOrDefault(order.accountId(), List.of())) {
  58            send(order.accountId(), subscriber, event);
  59        }
  60    }
  61
  62    /** Opens a stream for one account, first replaying anything after lastEventId. */
  63    public SseEmitter subscribe(String accountId, Long lastEventId, Function<Event, Object> renderer) {
  64        Subscriber subscriber = new Subscriber(new SseEmitter(TIMEOUT_MILLIS), renderer);
  65        subscriber.emitter().onCompletion(() -> unsubscribe(accountId, subscriber));
  66        subscriber.emitter().onTimeout(() -> unsubscribe(accountId, subscriber));
  67        if (lastEventId != null) {
  68            replay(accountId, lastEventId).forEach(event -> send(accountId, subscriber, event));
  69        }
  70        subscribers.computeIfAbsent(accountId, id -> new CopyOnWriteArrayList<>()).add(subscriber);
  71        return subscriber.emitter();
  72    }
  73
  74    /** Events for an account with an ID greater than lastEventId, oldest first. */
  75    public List<Event> replay(String accountId, long lastEventId) {
  76        Deque<Event> events = history.getOrDefault(accountId, new ArrayDeque<>());
  77        synchronized (events) {
  78            return events.stream().filter(event -> event.id() > lastEventId).toList();
  79        }
  80    }
  81
  82    private void send(String accountId, Subscriber subscriber, Event event) {
  83        try {
  84            subscriber.emitter().send(SseEmitter.event()
  85                    .id(Long.toString(event.id()))
  86                    .name(event.type())
  87                    .data(subscriber.renderer().apply(event), MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON));
  88        } catch (IOException | IllegalStateException gone) {
  89            unsubscribe(accountId, subscriber);
  90        }
  91    }
  92
  93    private void unsubscribe(String accountId, Subscriber subscriber) {
  94        subscribers.getOrDefault(accountId, List.of()).remove(subscriber);
  95    }
  96}

   1package com.example.brokerage.api.orders;
   2
   3import static org.springframework.hateoas.server.mvc.WebMvcLinkBuilder.afford;
   4import static org.springframework.hateoas.server.mvc.WebMvcLinkBuilder.linkTo;
   5import static org.springframework.hateoas.server.mvc.WebMvcLinkBuilder.methodOn;
   6
   7import com.example.brokerage.api.accounts.AccountController;
   8import com.example.brokerage.api.market.InstrumentController;
   9import com.example.brokerage.api.platform.Caller;
  10
  11import org.springframework.hateoas.EntityModel;
  12import org.springframework.hateoas.IanaLinkRelations;
  13import org.springframework.hateoas.Link;
  14import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
  15
  16/**
  17 * Builds an order's representation. This is where hypermedia earns its keep: the links
  18 * an order carries depend on its state and on the caller's token.
  19 *
  20 * <ul>
  21 *   <li>A working order, seen by a token with orders:write, offers "edit" (change it with
  22 *       PATCH) and "bk:cancel"; in HAL-FORMS both come with a template describing the
  23 *       request.</li>
  24 *   <li>A filled or canceled order offers neither. A client that shows buttons only for
  25 *       links that are present can never offer an action the server would refuse.</li>
  26 * </ul>
  27 */
  28@Component
  29public class OrderModelAssembler {
  30
  31    public EntityModel<Order> toModel(Order order, Caller caller) {
  32        String accountId = order.accountId();
  33        String orderId = order.id();
  34        boolean changeable = order.status().isWorking() && caller.canTrade();
  35
  36        Link self = linkTo(methodOn(OrderController.class).order(accountId, orderId, null, null))
  37                .withSelfRel();
  38        if (changeable) {
  39            self = self.andAffordance(afford(methodOn(OrderController.class)
  40                    .replaceOrder(accountId, orderId, null, null, null)));
  41        }
  42        EntityModel<Order> model = EntityModel.of(order, self,
  43                linkTo(methodOn(AccountController.class).account(accountId, null)).withRel("account"),
  44                linkTo(methodOn(InstrumentController.class).instrument(order.instrumentId()))
  45                        .withRel("instrument"));
  46
  47        if (changeable) {
  48            model.add(linkTo(methodOn(OrderController.class).order(accountId, orderId, null, null))
  49                    .withRel(IanaLinkRelations.EDIT));
  50            model.add(linkTo(methodOn(OrderController.class).cancelOrder(accountId, orderId, null))
  51                    .withRel("cancel")
  52                    .andAffordance(
  53                            afford(methodOn(OrderController.class).cancelOrder(accountId, orderId, null))));
  54        }
  55        return model;
  56    }
  57}

   1package com.example.brokerage.api.orders;

   3import java.math.BigDecimal;
   4
   5import jakarta.validation.constraints.Digits;
   6import jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank;
   7import jakarta.validation.constraints.NotNull;
   8import jakarta.validation.constraints.Pattern;
   9import jakarta.validation.constraints.Positive;
  10import jakarta.validation.constraints.Size;
  11
  12import org.springframework.hateoas.InputType;
  13
  14/**
  15 * The body of POST .../orders and POST .../order-previews. Field-level rules are declared
  16 * here and checked by Bean Validation; rules that involve several fields or the account
  17 * (a limit order needs a limit price, a sale needs shares to sell) live in OrderService.
  18 *
  19 * <p>This is a JavaBean rather than a record on purpose: Spring HATEOAS derives HAL-FORMS
  20 * templates from bean properties, and marks a property without a setter as read-only.
  21 */
  22public class OrderRequest {
  23
  24    @NotBlank
  25    private String instrumentId;
  26    @NotNull
  27    private Order.Side side;
  28    @NotNull
  29    private Order.Type type;
  30    private Order.TimeInForce timeInForce;
  31    @InputType("text") @NotNull @Positive @Digits(integer = 9, fraction = 6)
  32    private BigDecimal quantity;
  33    @InputType("text") @Positive @Digits(integer = 9, fraction = 4)
  34    private BigDecimal limitPrice;
  35    @InputType("text") @Positive @Digits(integer = 9, fraction = 4)
  36    private BigDecimal stopPrice;
  37    /** The caller's own reference for the order, echoed back unchanged. */
  38    @InputType("text") @Size(max = 64) @Pattern(regexp = "[A-Za-z0-9._-]*")
  39    private String clientOrderId;
  40
  41    public OrderRequest() {
  42    }
  43
  44    public OrderRequest(String instrumentId, Order.Side side, Order.Type type, Order.TimeInForce timeInForce,
  45            BigDecimal quantity, BigDecimal limitPrice, BigDecimal stopPrice, String clientOrderId) {
  46        this.instrumentId = instrumentId;
  47        this.side = side;
  48        this.type = type;
  49        this.timeInForce = timeInForce;
  50        this.quantity = quantity;
  51        this.limitPrice = limitPrice;
  52        this.stopPrice = stopPrice;
  53        this.clientOrderId = clientOrderId;
  54    }
  55
  56    public Order.TimeInForce timeInForceOrDefault() {
  57        return timeInForce == null ? Order.TimeInForce.DAY : timeInForce;
  58    }
  59
  60    /** A stable fingerprint, so a retried request can be recognized as the same request. */
  61    String fingerprint() {
  62        return String.join("|", instrumentId, side.name(), type.name(), timeInForceOrDefault().name(),
  63                plain(quantity), plain(limitPrice), plain(stopPrice), String.valueOf(clientOrderId));
  64    }
  65
  66    private static String plain(BigDecimal value) {
  67        return value == null ? "" : value.stripTrailingZeros().toPlainString();
  68    }
  69
  70    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- accessors
  71
  72    public String getInstrumentId() { return instrumentId; }
  73    public void setInstrumentId(String instrumentId) { this.instrumentId = instrumentId; }
  74    public Order.Side getSide() { return side; }
  75    public void setSide(Order.Side side) { this.side = side; }
  76    public Order.Type getType() { return type; }
  77    public void setType(Order.Type type) { this.type = type; }
  78    public Order.TimeInForce getTimeInForce() { return timeInForce; }
  79    public void setTimeInForce(Order.TimeInForce timeInForce) { this.timeInForce = timeInForce; }
  80    public BigDecimal getQuantity() { return quantity; }
  81    public void setQuantity(BigDecimal quantity) { this.quantity = quantity; }
  82    public BigDecimal getLimitPrice() { return limitPrice; }
  83    public void setLimitPrice(BigDecimal limitPrice) { this.limitPrice = limitPrice; }
  84    public BigDecimal getStopPrice() { return stopPrice; }
  85    public void setStopPrice(BigDecimal stopPrice) { this.stopPrice = stopPrice; }
  86    public String getClientOrderId() { return clientOrderId; }
  87    public void setClientOrderId(String clientOrderId) { this.clientOrderId = clientOrderId; }
  88}

   1package com.example.brokerage.api.orders;
   2
   3import java.math.BigDecimal;
   4import java.math.RoundingMode;
   5import java.time.Clock;
   6import java.time.Instant;
   7import java.util.ArrayList;
   8import java.util.Collection;
   9import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
  10import java.util.List;
  11import java.util.Map;
  12import java.util.Optional;
  13import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger;
  14
  15import com.example.brokerage.api.accounts.Account;
  16import com.example.brokerage.api.accounts.Holdings;
  17import com.example.brokerage.api.accounts.Ledger;
  18import com.example.brokerage.api.accounts.Reservations;
  19import com.example.brokerage.api.market.Instrument;
  20import com.example.brokerage.api.market.MarketData;
  21import com.example.brokerage.api.orders.Order.Side;
  22import com.example.brokerage.api.orders.Order.Status;
  23import com.example.brokerage.api.orders.Order.TimeInForce;
  24import com.example.brokerage.api.orders.Order.Type;
  25import com.example.brokerage.api.platform.ApiException;
  26import com.example.brokerage.api.platform.Caller;
  27import com.example.brokerage.api.platform.CursorPage;
  28import com.example.brokerage.api.platform.ProblemType;
  29
  30import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
  31
  32/**
  33 * Order placement, preview, amendment, cancellation and matching.
  34 *
  35 * <p>All state changes are serialized by one lock: simple and obviously correct, which
  36 * is what an example should be. A real system would partition by account.
  37 */
  38@Service
  39public class OrderService implements Reservations {
  40
  41    /** Placement result: the order, and whether this was a replay of an earlier request. */
  42    public record Placement(Order order, boolean replayed) {
  43    }
  44
  45    private static final BigDecimal OPTION_COMMISSION = new BigDecimal("0.65");
  46
  47    private final Map<String, Order> orders = new LinkedHashMap<>();
  48    private final AtomicInteger orderIds = new AtomicInteger(100_000);
  49    private final AtomicInteger fillIds = new AtomicInteger(500_000);
  50    private final Ledger ledger;
  51    private final MarketData market;
  52    private final IdempotencyKeys idempotencyKeys;
  53    private final OrderEvents events;
  54    private final Clock clock;
  55
  56    public OrderService(Ledger ledger, MarketData market, IdempotencyKeys idempotencyKeys,
  57            OrderEvents events, Clock clock) {
  58        this.ledger = ledger;
  59        this.market = market;
  60        this.idempotencyKeys = idempotencyKeys;
  61        this.events = events;
  62        this.clock = clock;
  63        // A resting limit order, so that there is something to change and cancel.
  64        Instant yesterday = clock.instant().minusSeconds(86_400);
  65        save(new Order(nextOrderId(), "ACC-1001", "rebalance-msft-01", "EQ-MSFT", "MSFT",
  66                Instrument.Type.EQUITY, Side.BUY, Type.LIMIT, TimeInForce.GTC, new BigDecimal("10"),
  67                new BigDecimal("480.00"), null, Status.OPEN, BigDecimal.ZERO, null, List.of(),
  68                yesterday, yesterday, false, 1));
  69    }
  70
  71    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- queries
  72
  73    public synchronized Order order(Caller caller, String accountId, String orderId) {
  74        ledger.account(caller.customerId(), accountId);
  75        Order order = orders.get(orderId);
  76        if (order == null || !order.accountId().equals(accountId)) {
  77            throw ApiException.notFound("Order", orderId);
  78        }
  79        return order;
  80    }
  81
  82    public synchronized CursorPage<Order> orders(Caller caller, String accountId,
  83            Collection<Status> statuses, String symbol, String cursor, Integer limit) {
  84        ledger.account(caller.customerId(), accountId);
  85        List<Order> matching = orders.values().stream()
  86                .filter(o -> o.accountId().equals(accountId))
  87                .filter(o -> statuses == null || statuses.isEmpty() || statuses.contains(o.status()))
  88                .filter(o -> symbol == null || o.symbol().equalsIgnoreCase(symbol))
  89                .toList();
  90        return CursorPage.of(matching, Order::createdAt, Order::id, cursor, limit);
  91    }
  92
  93    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- commands
  94
  95    public synchronized Placement place(Caller caller, String accountId, OrderRequest request,
  96            String idempotencyKey) {
  97        Account account = ledger.account(caller.customerId(), accountId);
  98        if (idempotencyKey == null || idempotencyKey.isBlank() || idempotencyKey.length() > 255) {
  99            throw new ApiException(ProblemType.IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_MISSING,
 100                    "Send a unique Idempotency-Key header (up to 255 characters) with every new order");
 101        }
 102        String scope = caller.clientId() + "|" + accountId;
 103        String fingerprint = request.fingerprint();
 104        Optional<String> earlier = idempotencyKeys.existingOrder(scope, idempotencyKey, fingerprint);
 105        if (earlier.isPresent()) {
 106            return new Placement(orders.get(earlier.get()), true);
 107        }
 108
 109        Assessment assessment = assess(caller, account, request);
 110        assessment.issues().stream().findFirst().ifPresent(issue -> {
 111            throw issue;
 112        });
 113
 114        Instant now = clock.instant();
 115        Instrument instrument = assessment.instrument();
 116        Order order = new Order(nextOrderId(), accountId, request.getClientOrderId(), instrument.id(),
 117                instrument.symbol(), instrument.type(), request.getSide(), request.getType(),
 118                request.timeInForceOrDefault(), request.getQuantity(), request.getLimitPrice(),
 119                request.getStopPrice(), Status.OPEN, BigDecimal.ZERO, null, List.of(), now, now,
 120                false, 1);
 121        save(order);
 122        idempotencyKeys.remember(scope, idempotencyKey, fingerprint, order.id());
 123        events.publish("order.created", order);
 124        return new Placement(order, false);
 125    }
 126
 127    public synchronized OrderPreview preview(Caller caller, String accountId, OrderRequest request) {
 128        Account account = ledger.account(caller.customerId(), accountId);
 129        Assessment assessment = assess(caller, account, request);
 130        List<OrderPreview.Issue> issues = assessment.issues().stream()
 131                .map(issue -> new OrderPreview.Issue(issue.type().uri(), issue.getMessage()))
 132                .toList();
 133        Instrument instrument = assessment.instrument();
 134        return new OrderPreview(accountId, request.getInstrumentId(),
 135                instrument == null ? null : instrument.symbol(), request.getSide(), request.getType(),
 136                request.getQuantity(), assessment.price(), assessment.notional(), assessment.commission(),
 137                assessment.total(), assessment.buyingPower(), issues.isEmpty(), issues);
 138    }
 139
 140    /**
 141     * Changes a working order. The If-Match header must carry the order's current ETag:
 142     * two clients editing the same order cannot silently overwrite one another.
 143     */
 144    public synchronized Order amend(Caller caller, String accountId, String orderId,
 145            OrderAmendment change, String ifMatch) {
 146        Order order = order(caller, accountId, orderId);
 147        if (ifMatch == null) {
 148            throw new ApiException(ProblemType.PRECONDITION_REQUIRED,
 149                    "Send If-Match with the order's current ETag to change it");
 150        }
 151        if (!ifMatch.equals(order.etag()) && !ifMatch.equals("*")) {
 152            throw new ApiException(ProblemType.PRECONDITION_FAILED,
 153                    "The order has changed since you read it; fetch it again and reapply your change")
 154                    .with("currentEtag", order.etag());
 155        }
 156        if (!order.status().isWorking()) {
 157            throw new ApiException(ProblemType.ORDER_NOT_REPLACEABLE,
 158                    "Order " + orderId + " is " + order.status() + " and can no longer be changed");
 159        }
 160        BigDecimal quantity = orElse(change.getQuantity(), order.quantity());
 161        if (quantity.compareTo(order.filledQuantity()) <= 0) {
 162            throw new ApiException(ProblemType.INVALID_REQUEST, "quantity must be greater than the "
 163                    + order.filledQuantity().toPlainString() + " already filled");
 164        }
 165        OrderRequest amended = new OrderRequest(order.instrumentId(), order.side(), order.type(),
 166                orElse(change.getTimeInForce(), order.timeInForce()), quantity,
 167                orElse(change.getLimitPrice(), order.limitPrice()),
 168                orElse(change.getStopPrice(), order.stopPrice()), order.clientOrderId());
 169
 170        Account account = ledger.account(caller.customerId(), accountId);
 171        orders.remove(orderId); // assess the new terms without this order's own reservation
 172        try {
 173            assess(caller, account, amended).issues().stream().findFirst().ifPresent(issue -> {
 174                throw issue;
 175            });
 176        } finally {
 177            orders.put(orderId, order);
 178        }
 179        Order updated = order.withTerms(amended.getQuantity(), amended.getLimitPrice(),
 180                amended.getStopPrice(), amended.getTimeInForce(), clock.instant());
 181        save(updated);
 182        events.publish("order.replaced", updated);
 183        return updated;
 184    }
 185
 186    /**
 187     * Requests cancellation. Like a real exchange, the cancel is asynchronous: the order
 188     * moves to PENDING_CANCEL now and to CANCELLED at the next matching pass, and it may
 189     * still fill in between.
 190     */
 191    public synchronized Order cancel(Caller caller, String accountId, String orderId) {
 192        Order order = order(caller, accountId, orderId);
 193        if (order.status() == Status.PENDING_CANCEL) {
 194            return order;
 195        }
 196        if (!order.status().isWorking()) {
 197            throw new ApiException(ProblemType.ORDER_NOT_CANCELLABLE,
 198                    "Order " + orderId + " is " + order.status() + " and cannot be canceled");
 199        }
 200        Order pending = order.withStatus(Status.PENDING_CANCEL, clock.instant());
 201        save(pending);
 202        events.publish("order.cancel-requested", pending);
 203        return pending;
 204    }
 205
 206    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- matching
 207
 208    /** One pass of the simulated exchange over every open order. */
 209    public synchronized void match() {
 210        for (Order order : List.copyOf(orders.values())) {
 211            if (order.status() == Status.PENDING_CANCEL) {
 212                Order cancelled = order.withStatus(Status.CANCELLED, clock.instant());
 213                save(cancelled);
 214                events.publish("order.cancelled", cancelled);
 215            } else if (order.status().isWorking()) {
 216                tryToFill(order);
 217            }
 218        }
 219    }
 220
 221    private void tryToFill(Order order) {
 222        Instrument instrument = market.instrument(order.instrumentId());
 223        MarketData.Tick tick = market.tick(instrument.id());
 224        boolean buy = order.side() == Side.BUY;
 225        Order current = order;
 226
 227        if ((order.type() == Type.STOP || order.type() == Type.STOP_LIMIT) && !order.stopTriggered()) {
 228            boolean triggered = buy ? tick.last().compareTo(order.stopPrice()) >= 0
 229                    : tick.last().compareTo(order.stopPrice()) <= 0;
 230            if (!triggered) {
 231                return;
 232            }
 233            current = current.withStopTriggered();
 234            save(current);
 235        }
 236
 237        BigDecimal price = buy ? tick.ask() : tick.bid();
 238        if (order.type() == Type.LIMIT || order.type() == Type.STOP_LIMIT) {
 239            boolean marketable = buy ? price.compareTo(order.limitPrice()) <= 0
 240                    : price.compareTo(order.limitPrice()) >= 0;
 241            if (!marketable) {
 242                return;
 243            }
 244        }
 245
 246        BigDecimal displayed = buy ? tick.askSize() : tick.bidSize();
 247        BigDecimal quantity = current.remainingQuantity().min(displayed);
 248        Instant now = clock.instant();
 249        ledger.recordTrade(order.accountId(), instrument, buy ? quantity : quantity.negate(), price,
 250                commission(instrument, quantity), order.id(), now);
 251        String fillId = "FIL-" + fillIds.incrementAndGet();
 252        Order filled = current.withFill(new Order.Fill(fillId, quantity, price, now));
 253        save(filled);
 254        boolean complete = filled.status() == Status.FILLED;
 255        events.publish(complete ? "order.filled" : "order.partially-filled", filled);
 256    }
 257
 258    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- reservations
 259
 260    @Override
 261    public synchronized BigDecimal reservedCash(String accountId) {
 262        return orders.values().stream()
 263                .filter(o -> o.accountId().equals(accountId))
 264                .filter(o -> o.side() == Side.BUY && o.status().isOpen())
 265                .map(o -> {
 266                    Instrument instrument = market.instrument(o.instrumentId());
 267                    BigDecimal price = referencePrice(o.type(), Side.BUY, o.limitPrice(),
 268                            o.stopPrice(), instrument);
 269                    return price.multiply(o.remainingQuantity()).multiply(instrument.multiplier())
 270                            .add(commission(instrument, o.remainingQuantity()));
 271                })
 272                .reduce(BigDecimal.ZERO, BigDecimal::add)
 273                .setScale(2, RoundingMode.HALF_EVEN);
 274    }
 275
 276    @Override
 277    public synchronized BigDecimal reservedQuantity(String accountId, String instrumentId) {
 278        return orders.values().stream()
 279                .filter(o -> o.accountId().equals(accountId) && o.instrumentId().equals(instrumentId))
 280                .filter(o -> o.side() == Side.SELL && o.status().isOpen())
 281                .map(Order::remainingQuantity)
 282                .reduce(BigDecimal.ZERO, BigDecimal::add);
 283    }
 284
 285    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- the rules
 286
 287    /** The outcome of checking an order request against the rules, without acting on it. */
 288    private record Assessment(Instrument instrument, BigDecimal price, BigDecimal notional,
 289            BigDecimal commission, BigDecimal total, BigDecimal buyingPower,
 290            List<ApiException> issues) {
 291
 292        static Assessment failed(Instrument instrument, List<ApiException> issues) {
 293            return new Assessment(instrument, null, null, null, null, null, issues);
 294        }
 295    }
 296
 297    private Assessment assess(Caller caller, Account account, OrderRequest request) {
 298        List<ApiException> issues = new ArrayList<>();
 299        Instrument instrument;
 300        try {
 301            instrument = market.instrument(request.getInstrumentId());
 302        } catch (ApiException notFound) {
 303            issues.add(new ApiException(ProblemType.INSTRUMENT_NOT_TRADABLE,
 304                    "Instrument " + request.getInstrumentId() + " does not exist"));
 305            return Assessment.failed(null, issues);
 306        }
 307
 308        checkPrices(request, issues);
 309        if (!instrument.tradable()) {
 310            issues.add(new ApiException(ProblemType.INSTRUMENT_NOT_TRADABLE,
 311                    instrument.symbol() + " is not tradable"));
 312        }
 313        boolean wholeUnits = request.getQuantity().stripTrailingZeros().scale() <= 0;
 314        if (!wholeUnits && (!instrument.fractionable() || request.getType() != Type.MARKET)) {
 315            issues.add(new ApiException(ProblemType.INVALID_REQUEST,
 316                    "Fractional quantities are allowed only in market orders for fractionable stocks"));
 317        }
 318        if (!issues.isEmpty()) {
 319            return Assessment.failed(instrument, issues);
 320        }
 321
 322        BigDecimal price = referencePrice(request.getType(), request.getSide(),
 323                request.getLimitPrice(), request.getStopPrice(), instrument);
 324        BigDecimal notional = price.multiply(request.getQuantity())
 325                .multiply(instrument.multiplier())
 326                .setScale(2, RoundingMode.HALF_EVEN);
 327        BigDecimal commission = commission(instrument, request.getQuantity());
 328        boolean buy = request.getSide() == Side.BUY;
 329        BigDecimal total = buy ? notional.add(commission) : notional.subtract(commission);
 330        BigDecimal buyingPower = Holdings.buyingPower(account.type(), ledger.cash(account.id()),
 331                reservedCash(account.id()));
 332
 333        if (buy && total.compareTo(buyingPower) > 0) {
 334            issues.add(new ApiException(ProblemType.INSUFFICIENT_BUYING_POWER,
 335                    "This order needs " + total.toPlainString() + " but only "
 336                            + buyingPower.toPlainString() + " is available")
 337                    .with("required", total).with("available", buyingPower));
 338        }
 339        if (!buy) {
 340            BigDecimal available = ledger.quantityHeld(account.id(), instrument.id())
 341                    .subtract(reservedQuantity(account.id(), instrument.id()));
 342            if (request.getQuantity().compareTo(available) > 0) {
 343                issues.add(new ApiException(ProblemType.INSUFFICIENT_POSITION,
 344                        "Only " + available.toPlainString() + " " + instrument.symbol()
 345                                + " are available to sell; short selling is not supported")
 346                        .with("available", available));
 347            }
 348        }
 349        caller.tradingLimit().filter(limit -> notional.compareTo(limit) > 0).ifPresent(limit ->
 350                issues.add(new ApiException(ProblemType.TRADING_LIMIT_EXCEEDED,
 351                        "This client may place orders up to " + limit.toPlainString()
 352                                + " USD; this one is " + notional.toPlainString())
 353                        .with("tradingLimit", limit)));
 354        return new Assessment(instrument, price, notional, commission, total, buyingPower, issues);
 355    }
 356
 357    private static void checkPrices(OrderRequest request, List<ApiException> issues) {
 358        Type type = request.getType();
 359        boolean needsLimit = type == Type.LIMIT || type == Type.STOP_LIMIT;
 360        boolean needsStop = type == Type.STOP || type == Type.STOP_LIMIT;
 361        if (needsLimit != (request.getLimitPrice() != null)) {
 362            issues.add(new ApiException(ProblemType.INVALID_REQUEST, needsLimit
 363                    ? "limitPrice is required for " + type + " orders"
 364                    : "limitPrice is not allowed for " + type + " orders"));
 365        }
 366        if (needsStop != (request.getStopPrice() != null)) {
 367            issues.add(new ApiException(ProblemType.INVALID_REQUEST, needsStop
 368                    ? "stopPrice is required for " + type + " orders"
 369                    : "stopPrice is not allowed for " + type + " orders"));
 370        }
 371    }
 372
 373    /** The price used to estimate cost and reserve cash: the worst price the order can get. */
 374    private BigDecimal referencePrice(Type type, Side side, BigDecimal limit, BigDecimal stop,
 375            Instrument instrument) {
 376        return switch (type) {
 377            case LIMIT, STOP_LIMIT -> limit;
 378            case STOP -> stop;
 379            case MARKET -> {
 380                MarketData.Tick tick = market.tick(instrument.id());
 381                yield side == Side.BUY ? tick.ask() : tick.bid();
 382            }
 383        };
 384    }
 385
 386    private static BigDecimal commission(Instrument instrument, BigDecimal quantity) {
 387        BigDecimal perUnit = instrument.isOption() ? OPTION_COMMISSION : BigDecimal.ZERO;
 388        return perUnit.multiply(quantity).setScale(2, RoundingMode.HALF_EVEN);
 389    }
 390
 391    private static <T> T orElse(T value, T fallback) {
 392        return value != null ? value : fallback;
 393    }
 394
 395    private void save(Order order) {
 396        orders.put(order.id(), order);
 397    }
 398
 399    private String nextOrderId() {
 400        return "ORD-" + orderIds.incrementAndGet();
 401    }
 402}

   1package com.example.brokerage.api.orders;
   2
   3import com.example.brokerage.api.market.MarketData;
   4
   5import org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.condition.ConditionalOnBooleanProperty;
   6import org.springframework.scheduling.annotation.Scheduled;
   7import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
   8
   9/**
  10 * Drives the simulated market: every tick, prices move and open orders are matched.
  11 * Tests switch this off (brokerage.simulator.enabled=false) and call match() directly,
  12 * so that every price is known in advance.
  13 */
  14@Component
  15@ConditionalOnBooleanProperty(name = "brokerage.simulator.enabled", matchIfMissing = true)
  16class TradingSession {
  17
  18    private final MarketData market;
  19    private final OrderService orders;
  20
  21    TradingSession(MarketData market, OrderService orders) {
  22        this.market = market;
  23        this.orders = orders;
  24    }
  25
  26    @Scheduled(fixedDelayString = "${brokerage.simulator.tick-millis:1000}")
  27    void tick() {
  28        market.move();
  29        orders.match();
  30    }
  31}

   1package com.example.brokerage.api;
   2
   3import static org.springframework.security.test.web.servlet.request.SecurityMockMvcRequestPostProcessors.jwt;
   4
   5import java.lang.annotation.ElementType;
   6import java.lang.annotation.Retention;
   7import java.lang.annotation.RetentionPolicy;
   8import java.lang.annotation.Target;
   9import java.util.ArrayList;
  10import java.util.List;
  11
  12import org.springframework.boot.test.context.SpringBootTest;
  13import org.springframework.boot.webmvc.test.autoconfigure.AutoConfigureMockMvc;
  14import org.springframework.test.web.servlet.request.RequestPostProcessor;
  15
  16/**
  17 * The whole application, with the simulated market frozen: prices never move by
  18 * themselves, and orders fill only when a test calls OrderService.match().
  19 */
  20@Target(ElementType.TYPE)
  21@Retention(RetentionPolicy.RUNTIME)
  22@SpringBootTest(properties = "brokerage.simulator.enabled=false")
  23@AutoConfigureMockMvc
  24public @interface ApiTest {
  25
  26    /** Access tokens for tests, as the authorization server would issue them. */
  27    final class Tokens {
  28
  29        public static final String MARKET_DATA = "market-data:read";
  30        public static final String ACCOUNTS = "accounts:read";
  31        public static final String ORDERS_READ = "orders:read";
  32        public static final String ORDERS_WRITE = "orders:write";
  33        public static final String[] ALL = { MARKET_DATA, ACCOUNTS, ORDERS_READ, ORDERS_WRITE };
  34
  35        private Tokens() {
  36        }
  37
  38        /** Alice (customer cust-1001) through her own script, the brokerage-cli client. */
  39        public static RequestPostProcessor alice(String... scopes) {
  40            return token("brokerage-cli", "cust-1001", null, scopes);
  41        }
  42
  43        /** Alice's AI agent: same customer, orders capped at the given notional. */
  44        public static RequestPostProcessor agent(String tradingLimit, String... scopes) {
  45            return token("brokerage-agent", "cust-1001", tradingLimit, scopes);
  46        }
  47
  48        /** Bob (customer cust-2002), who must never see Alice's accounts. */
  49        public static RequestPostProcessor bob(String... scopes) {
  50            return token("bob-app", "cust-2002", null, scopes);
  51        }
  52
  53        private static RequestPostProcessor token(String client, String customer, String limit,
  54                String... scopes) {
  55            return jwt().jwt(token -> {
  56                token.subject(client).audience(List.of("brokerage-api")).claim("customer_id", customer)
  57                        .claim("scope", new ArrayList<>(List.of(scopes)));
  58                if (limit != null) {
  59                    token.claim("trading_limit", limit);
  60                }
  61            });
  62        }
  63    }
  64}

  30/**
  31 * The OpenAPI document is a contract, so it is tested like code: it must be a valid
  32 * OpenAPI 3.2 document, its examples must match its own schemas, and real responses from
  33 * the running application must match the schemas it promises.
  34 */
  35@ApiTest
  36class ContractTest {
  37
  38    static final String CONTRACT = "https://api.brokerage.example/openapi.yaml";
  39    static final String OAS_32 = "https://spec.openapis.org/oas/3.2/schema/2025-09-17";
  40
  41    static JsonNode contract;
  42    static SchemaRegistry schemas;
  43
  44    @Autowired
  45    MockMvcTester mvc;
  46
  47    @BeforeAll
  48    static void loadTheContract() throws IOException {
  49        try (InputStream yaml = new ClassPathResource("contract/brokerage-api.yaml").getInputStream();
  50                InputStream meta = new ClassPathResource("oas-3.2-schema.json").getInputStream()) {
  51            contract = YAMLMapper.builder().build().readTree(yaml);
  52            String metaSchema = new String(meta.readAllBytes());
  53            String contractJson = JsonMapper.builder().build().writeValueAsString(contract);
  54            schemas = SchemaRegistry.withDefaultDialect(SpecificationVersion.DRAFT_2020_12,
  55                    registry -> registry.schemas(Map.of(CONTRACT, contractJson, OAS_32, metaSchema)));
  56        }
  57    }
  58
  59    @Test
  60    void theContractIsAValidOpenApi32Document() {
  61        List<Error> errors = schemas.getSchema(SchemaLocation.of(OAS_32)).validate(contract);
  62        assertThat(errors).as("violations of the OpenAPI 3.2 meta-schema").isEmpty();
  63    }
  64
  65    @Test
  66    void theMetaSchemaCheckCatchesABrokenContract() {
  67        ObjectNode broken = (ObjectNode) contract.deepCopy();
  68        broken.remove("info");
  69        broken.put("openapi", "3.2");
  70        assertThat(schemas.getSchema(SchemaLocation.of(OAS_32)).validate(broken)).isNotEmpty();
  71    }
  72
  73    @Test
  74    void everyExampleMatchesItsOwnSchema() {
  75        JsonNode placeOrder = contract.at("/paths/~1accounts~1{accountId}~1orders/post/requestBody/content/"
  76                + "application~1json/examples/limitBuy/dataValue");
  77        assertMatches("OrderRequest", placeOrder);
  78        for (String response : List.of("BadRequest", "UnprocessableContent")) {
  79            contract.at("/components/responses/" + response + "/content/application~1problem+json/examples")
  80                    .forEach(example -> assertMatches("Problem", example.get("dataValue")));
  81        }
  82    }
  83
  84    @Test
  85    void readOnlyResourcesMatchTheirSchemas() throws Exception {
  86        assertMatches("ApiRoot", get("/"));
  87        assertMatches("AccountCollection", get("/accounts"));
  88        assertMatches("Account", get("/accounts/ACC-1001"));
  89        assertMatches("Balances", get("/accounts/ACC-1001/balances"));
  90        assertMatches("PositionCollection", get("/accounts/ACC-1001/positions"));
  91        assertMatches("Position", get("/accounts/ACC-1001/positions/EQ-AAPL"));
  92        assertMatches("TransactionPage", get("/accounts/ACC-1001/transactions?limit=5"));
  93        assertMatches("InstrumentCollection", get("/instruments?type=EQUITY"));
  94        assertMatches("InstrumentCollection", get("/instruments/EQ-AAPL/option-chain"));
  95        assertMatches("QuoteV1", get("/instruments/EQ-AAPL/quote"));
  96        assertMatches("OrderPage", get("/accounts/ACC-1001/orders"));
  97        assertMatches("ProtectedResourceMetadata", get("/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource"));
  98    }
  99
 100    @Test
 101    void ordersPreviewsAndProblemsMatchTheirSchemas() throws Exception {
 102        MvcTestResult placed = mvc.post().uri("/accounts/ACC-1001/orders").with(alice(ALL))
 103                .header("Idempotency-Key", UUID.randomUUID().toString())
 104                .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
 105                .content("""
 106                        {"instrumentId": "EQ-AAPL", "side": "BUY", "type": "LIMIT", "quantity": "1",
 107                         "limitPrice": "200.00", "clientOrderId": "contract-test"}""")
 108                .exchange();
 109        assertMatches("Order", json(placed));
 110
 111        MvcTestResult preview = mvc.post().uri("/accounts/ACC-1001/order-previews").with(alice(ALL))
 112                .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
 113                .content("""
 114                        {"instrumentId": "EQ-AAPL", "side": "BUY", "type": "MARKET", "quantity": "3"}""")
 115                .exchange();
 116        assertMatches("OrderPreview", json(preview));
 117
 118        MvcTestResult problem = mvc.post().uri("/accounts/ACC-1001/orders").with(alice(ALL))
 119                .header("Idempotency-Key", UUID.randomUUID().toString())
 120                .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
 121                .content("""
 122                        {"instrumentId": "EQ-HALT", "side": "BUY", "type": "MARKET", "quantity": "1"}""")
 123                .exchange();
 124        assertThat(problem).hasStatus(422);
 125        assertMatches("Problem", json(problem));
 126
 127        MvcTestResult v2 = mvc.get().uri("/instruments/EQ-AAPL/quote").header("API-Version", "2")
 128                .with(alice(ALL)).exchange();
 129        assertMatches("Quote", json(v2));
 130    }

 132    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- helpers
 133
 134    private JsonNode get(String uri) throws Exception {
 135        MvcTestResult result = mvc.get().uri(uri).with(alice(ALL)).exchange();
 136        assertThat(result).as(uri).hasStatusOk();
 137        return json(result);
 138    }

 140    private static JsonNode json(MvcTestResult result) throws Exception {
 141        return JsonMapper.builder().build().readTree(result.getResponse().getContentAsString());
 142    }
 143
 144    private static void assertMatches(String schemaName, JsonNode instance) {
 145        SchemaLocation location = SchemaLocation.of(CONTRACT + "#/components/schemas/" + schemaName);
 146        List<Error> errors = schemas.getSchema(location).validate(instance);
 147        assertThat(errors).as("%s does not match the contract:%n%s", schemaName, instance).isEmpty();
 148    }

  17/**

  45    @Test

  48                .bodyJson().extractingPath("$.authorization_servers[0]").isEqualTo("http://localhost:9000");

  64                .bodyJson().extractingPath("$.type").isEqualTo(PROBLEMS + "insufficient-scope");

  74    @Test

  83        // A full trading token, asking for HAL-FORMS: the placeOrder template appears.

  19/**
  20 * Placing, retrying, changing and canceling orders, and the links that follow each state.
  21 */
  22@ApiTest
  23class OrderLifecycleTest {
  24
  25    static final String ORDERS = "/accounts/ACC-1001/orders";
  26    static final String PROBLEMS = "https://docs.brokerage.example/problems/";
  27    static final MediaType MERGE_PATCH = MediaType.parseMediaType("application/merge-patch+json");
  28
  29    @Autowired
  30    MockMvcTester mvc;
  31
  32    @Autowired
  33    OrderService orders;
  34
  35    @Test
  36    void aMarketOrderIsCreatedThenFilledAndLosesItsCancelLink() {
  37        MvcTestResult placed = place(UUID.randomUUID().toString(), """
  38                {"instrumentId": "EQ-AAPL", "side": "BUY", "type": "MARKET", "quantity": "2"}""");
  39        assertThat(placed).hasStatus(HttpStatus.CREATED);
  40        assertThat(placed.getResponse().getHeader("Location")).contains(ORDERS + "/ORD-");
  41        assertThat(placed.getResponse().getHeader("ETag")).isNotBlank();
  42        assertThat(placed).bodyJson().extractingPath("$.status").isEqualTo("OPEN");
  43        assertThat(placed).bodyJson().hasPath("$._links['bk:cancel']").hasPath("$._links.edit");
  44
  45        orders.match();
  46
  47        String url = placed.getResponse().getHeader("Location");
  48        MvcTestResult filled = mvc.get().uri(url).with(alice(ALL)).exchange();
  49        assertThat(filled).bodyJson().extractingPath("$.status").isEqualTo("FILLED");
  50        // AAPL is frozen at 232.40, so the ask is 232.42.
  51        assertThat(filled).bodyJson().extractingPath("$.averageFillPrice").isEqualTo("232.4200");
  52        assertThat(filled).bodyJson()
  53                .doesNotHavePath("$._links['bk:cancel']")
  54                .doesNotHavePath("$._links.edit");
  55    }
  56
  57    @Test
  58    void retryingWithTheSameKeyReturnsTheSameOrder() {
  59        String key = UUID.randomUUID().toString();
  60        String body = """
  61                {"instrumentId": "EQ-MSFT", "side": "BUY", "type": "LIMIT", "quantity": "1",
  62                 "limitPrice": "400.00"}""";
  63        MvcTestResult first = place(key, body);
  64        MvcTestResult retry = place(key, body);
  65
  66        assertThat(retry).hasStatus(HttpStatus.CREATED);
  67        assertThat(retry.getResponse().getHeader("Location"))
  68                .isEqualTo(first.getResponse().getHeader("Location"));
  69        assertThat(retry.getResponse().getHeader("Idempotent-Replayed")).isEqualTo("true");
  70
  71        MvcTestResult different = place(key, body.replace("\"1\"", "\"2\""));
  72        assertThat(different).hasStatus(HttpStatus.UNPROCESSABLE_CONTENT)
  73                .bodyJson().extractingPath("$.type").isEqualTo(PROBLEMS + "idempotency-key-reused");
  74    }

  76    @Test
  77    void anOrderWithoutAnIdempotencyKeyIsRefused() {

  79                .content("""
  80                        {"instrumentId": "EQ-AAPL", "side": "BUY", "type": "MARKET", "quantity": "1"}"""))
  81                .hasStatus(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST)
  82                .bodyJson().extractingPath("$.type").isEqualTo(PROBLEMS + "idempotency-key-missing");

  89                 "limitPrice": "500"}""");
  90        assertThat(tooBig).hasStatus(HttpStatus.UNPROCESSABLE_CONTENT);

  92                .isEqualTo(PROBLEMS + "insufficient-buying-power");
  93        assertThat(tooBig).bodyJson().extractingPath("$.required").isEqualTo("500000.00");
  94        assertThat(tooBig).bodyJson().hasPath("$.available");
  95    }
  96
  97    @Test
  98    void theAgentsDelegatedTradingLimitIsEnforcedByTheApi() {
  99        // 30 x 232.42 = 6,972.60, above the agent's 5,000 limit.
 100        assertThat(mvc.post().uri(ORDERS).with(agent("5000", ALL))
 101                .header("Idempotency-Key", UUID.randomUUID().toString())
 102                .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
 103                .content("""
 104                        {"instrumentId": "EQ-AAPL", "side": "BUY", "type": "MARKET", "quantity": "30"}"""))
 105                .hasStatus(HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN)
 106                .bodyJson().extractingPath("$.type").isEqualTo(PROBLEMS + "trading-limit-exceeded");
 107    }
 108
 109    @Test
 110    void changingAnOrderRequiresItsCurrentEtag() {
 111        MvcTestResult placed = place(UUID.randomUUID().toString(), """
 112                {"instrumentId": "EQ-NVDA", "side": "BUY", "type": "LIMIT", "quantity": "5",
 113                 "limitPrice": "150.00"}""");
 114        String url = placed.getResponse().getHeader("Location");
 115        String etag = placed.getResponse().getHeader("ETag");
 116
 117        // Polling an unchanged order costs a 304 and no body.
 118        assertThat(mvc.get().uri(url).with(alice(ALL)).header("If-None-Match", etag))
 119                .hasStatus(HttpStatus.NOT_MODIFIED);
 120
 121        assertThat(amend(url, null, """
 122                {"limitPrice": "151.00"}""")).hasStatus(HttpStatus.PRECONDITION_REQUIRED);
 123
 124        MvcTestResult changed = amend(url, etag, """
 125                {"limitPrice": "151.00"}""");
 126        assertThat(changed).hasStatusOk();
 127        assertThat(changed).bodyJson().extractingPath("$.limitPrice").isEqualTo("151.00");
 128        assertThat(changed.getResponse().getHeader("ETag")).isNotEqualTo(etag);
 129
 130        // The old ETag is now stale: a second writer holding it is refused, not merged.
 131        assertThat(amend(url, etag, """
 132                {"limitPrice": "152.00"}"""))
 133                .hasStatus(HttpStatus.PRECONDITION_FAILED)
 134                .bodyJson().extractingPath("$.type").isEqualTo(PROBLEMS + "precondition-failed");
 135    }
 136
 137    @Test
 138    void cancellationIsAcceptedThenCompletes() {
 139        MvcTestResult placed = place(UUID.randomUUID().toString(), """
 140                {"instrumentId": "ETF-SPY", "side": "SELL", "type": "LIMIT", "quantity": "1",
 141                 "limitPrice": "900.00"}""");
 142        String url = placed.getResponse().getHeader("Location");
 143
 144        MvcTestResult cancel = mvc.post().uri(url + "/cancellation").with(alice(ALL)).exchange();
 145        assertThat(cancel).hasStatus(HttpStatus.ACCEPTED);
 146        assertThat(cancel.getResponse().getHeader("Location")).isEqualTo(url);
 147        assertThat(cancel).bodyJson().extractingPath("$.status").isEqualTo("PENDING_CANCEL");
 148
 149        orders.match();
 150
 151        assertThat(mvc.get().uri(url).with(alice(ALL)))
 152                .bodyJson().extractingPath("$.status").isEqualTo("CANCELLED");
 153        assertThat(mvc.post().uri(url + "/cancellation").with(alice(ALL)))
 154                .hasStatus(HttpStatus.CONFLICT)
 155                .bodyJson().extractingPath("$.type").isEqualTo(PROBLEMS + "order-not-cancellable");
 156    }
 157
 158    @Test
 159    void aPreviewReportsProblemsWithoutPlacingAnything() {
 160        MvcTestResult preview = mvc.post().uri("/accounts/ACC-1001/order-previews").with(alice(ALL))
 161                .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
 162                .content("""
 163                        {"instrumentId": "EQ-AMZN", "side": "SELL", "type": "MARKET", "quantity": "500"}""")
 164                .exchange();
 165        assertThat(preview).hasStatusOk();
 166        assertThat(preview).bodyJson().extractingPath("$.acceptable").isEqualTo(false);
 167        assertThat(preview).bodyJson().extractingPath("$.issues[0].type")
 168                .isEqualTo(PROBLEMS + "insufficient-position");
 169        assertThat(preview).bodyJson().doesNotHavePath("$._links['bk:place-order']");
 170    }
 171
 172    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- helpers
 173
 174    private MvcTestResult place(String idempotencyKey, String json) {
 175        return mvc.post().uri(ORDERS).with(alice(ALL)).header("Idempotency-Key", idempotencyKey)
 176                .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).content(json).exchange();
 177    }
 178
 179    private MvcTestResult amend(String url, String ifMatch, String json) {
 180        var request = mvc.patch().uri(url).with(alice(ALL)).contentType(MERGE_PATCH).content(json);
 181        return (ifMatch == null ? request : request.header("If-Match", ifMatch)).exchange();
 182    }
 183}

   1package com.example.brokerage.client;
   2
   3import java.io.IOException;
   4import java.util.Optional;
   5
   6import tools.jackson.databind.JsonNode;
   7import tools.jackson.databind.json.JsonMapper;
   8
   9import org.springframework.http.client.ClientHttpResponse;
  10
  11/**
  12 * An RFC 9457 problem returned by the API, as an exception. Callers branch on {@link #type()},
  13 * the stable identifier, and may show {@link #detail()} to a person.
  14 */
  15public class ApiProblem extends RuntimeException {
  16
  17    private final int status;
  18    private final String type;
  19    private final String title;
  20    private final JsonNode body;
  21    private final Optional<Long> retryAfterSeconds;
  22
  23    ApiProblem(int status, String type, String title, String detail, JsonNode body,
  24            Optional<Long> retryAfter) {
  25        super(status + " " + title + (detail == null ? "" : ": " + detail));
  26        this.status = status;
  27        this.type = type;
  28        this.title = title;
  29        this.body = body;
  30        this.retryAfterSeconds = retryAfter;
  31    }
  32
  33    static ApiProblem from(ClientHttpResponse response, JsonMapper json) throws IOException {
  34        JsonNode body = json.readTree(response.getBody());
  35        int status = response.getStatusCode().value();
  36        Optional<Long> retryAfter = Optional.ofNullable(response.getHeaders().getFirst("Retry-After"))
  37                .map(Long::valueOf);
  38        return new ApiProblem(status, body.path("type").asString("about:blank"),
  39                body.path("title").asString(response.getStatusText()), body.path("detail").asString(null),
  40                body, retryAfter);
  41    }
  42
  43    /** Worth retrying later with the same request (and the same Idempotency-Key). */
  44    public boolean isTransient() {
  45        return status == 429 || status == 502 || status == 503 || status == 504;
  46    }
  47
  48    /** The problem type's short name, such as "insufficient-buying-power". */
  49    public String typeName() {
  50        return type.substring(type.lastIndexOf('/') + 1);
  51    }
  52

   1package com.example.brokerage.client;
   2
   3import java.net.URI;
   4import java.time.Duration;
   5import java.util.List;
   6import java.util.Map;
   7
   8import com.example.brokerage.client.Model.Account;
   9import com.example.brokerage.client.Model.Balances;
  10import com.example.brokerage.client.Model.Instrument;
  11import com.example.brokerage.client.Model.Order;
  12import com.example.brokerage.client.Model.OrderPreview;
  13import com.example.brokerage.client.Model.OrderTicket;
  14import com.example.brokerage.client.Model.Position;
  15import com.example.brokerage.client.Model.Quote;
  16
  17import org.springframework.hateoas.Link;
  18import org.springframework.web.client.ResourceAccessException;
  19
  20/**
  21 * The brokerage, as a Java API. Every method starts from the API root and follows link
  22 * relations; not one URL is built here. If the server moves a resource, this class keeps
  23 * working, and if the server withholds a link, the corresponding action is unavailable.
  24 */
  25public class BrokerageClient {
  26
  27    private static final int ATTEMPTS = 3;
  28
  29    private final HypermediaClient http;
  30    private final URI root;
  31
  32    public BrokerageClient(HypermediaClient http, URI root) {
  33        this.http = http;
  34        this.root = root;
  35    }
  36
  37    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- accounts
  38
  39    public List<Account> accounts() {
  40        return accountResources().stream().map(account -> account.as(Account.class)).toList();
  41    }
  42
  43    public Balances balances(String accountId) {
  44        return follow(account(accountId), "bk:balances").as(Balances.class);
  45    }
  46
  47    public List<Position> positions(String accountId) {
  48        return follow(account(accountId), "bk:positions").embedded("bk:positions").stream()
  49                .map(position -> position.as(Position.class)).toList();
  50    }
  51
  52    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- market data
  53
  54    public Instrument instrument(String symbol) {
  55        return instrumentResource(symbol).as(Instrument.class);
  56    }
  57
  58    /** The latest quote, in the version 2 shape that the client pins on every request. */
  59    public Quote quote(String symbol) {
  60        Link quote = instrumentResource(symbol).requiredLink("bk:quote");
  61        return http.get(quote.toUri()).as(Quote.class);
  62    }
  63
  64    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- trading
  65
  66    public OrderPreview preview(String accountId, OrderTicket ticket) {
  67        Link previews = account(accountId).requiredLink("bk:order-previews");
  68        return http.post(previews, ticket, headers -> { }).as(OrderPreview.class);
  69    }
  70
  71    /**
  72     * Places an order. On a timeout or a transient error the request is retried with the
  73     * same Idempotency-Key, so a retry can never place a second order.
  74     */
  75    public Order place(String accountId, OrderTicket ticket, String idempotencyKey) {
  76        Link orders = account(accountId).requiredLink("bk:orders").expand();
  77        for (int attempt = 1; ; attempt++) {
  78            try {
  79                return http.post(orders, ticket, headers -> headers.set("Idempotency-Key", idempotencyKey))
  80                        .as(Order.class);
  81            } catch (ResourceAccessException | ApiProblem failure) {
  82                boolean retryable = !(failure instanceof ApiProblem problem) || problem.isTransient();
  83                if (!retryable || attempt == ATTEMPTS) {
  84                    throw failure;
  85                }
  86                long seconds = failure instanceof ApiProblem problem
  87                        ? problem.retryAfterSeconds().orElse(1L) : attempt;
  88                pause(seconds);
  89            }
  90        }
  91    }
  92
  93    public List<Order> openOrders(String accountId) {
  94        Link orders = account(accountId).requiredLink("bk:orders");
  95        URI open = orders.expand(Map.of("status", List.of("OPEN", "PARTIALLY_FILLED"))).toUri();
  96        return http.get(open).embedded("bk:orders").stream().map(order -> order.as(Order.class)).toList();
  97    }
  98
  99    /** Re-reads an order through its own self link. */
 100    public Order refresh(Order order) {
 101        return http.get(order.self()).as(Order.class);
 102    }
 103
 104    /** Cancels an order, if and only if the server still offers the cancel link. */
 105    public Order cancel(Order order) {
 106        URI cancel = order.link("bk:cancel").orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalStateException(
 107                "Order " + order.id() + " is " + order.status() + " and can no longer be canceled"));
 108        return http.post(Link.of(cancel.toString()), null, headers -> { }).as(Order.class);
 109    }
 110
 111    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- navigation
 112
 113    private List<HalResource> accountResources() {
 114        HalResource start = http.get(root);
 115        return follow(start, "bk:accounts").embedded("bk:accounts");
 116    }
 117
 118    private HalResource account(String accountId) {
 119        return accountResources().stream()
 120                .filter(account -> accountId.equals(account.body().path("id").asString()))
 121                .findFirst()
 122                .orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalArgumentException(
 123                        "No account " + accountId + " for this customer"));
 124    }
 125
 126    private HalResource instrumentResource(String symbol) {
 127        Link search = http.get(root).requiredLink("bk:instruments");
 128        return http.get(search.expand(Map.of("symbol", symbol)).toUri()).embedded("bk:instruments").stream()
 129                .findFirst()
 130                .orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown symbol " + symbol));
 131    }
 132
 133    private HalResource follow(HalResource from, String rel) {
 134        return http.get(from.requiredLink(rel).expand().toUri());
 135    }
 136
 137    private static void pause(long seconds) {
 138        try {
 139            Thread.sleep(Duration.ofSeconds(Math.min(seconds, 5)));
 140        } catch (InterruptedException interrupted) {
 141            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
 142            throw new IllegalStateException(interrupted);
 143        }
 144    }
 145}

brokerage-client/src/main/java/com/example/brokerage/client/ClientCredentials.java53 lines

   1package com.example.brokerage.client;
   2
   3import java.net.URI;
   4import java.time.Instant;
   5import java.util.function.Supplier;
   6
   7import tools.jackson.databind.JsonNode;
   8
   9import org.springframework.http.MediaType;
  10import org.springframework.util.LinkedMultiValueMap;
  11import org.springframework.util.MultiValueMap;
  12import org.springframework.web.client.RestClient;
  13
  14/**
  15 * Access tokens by the OAuth 2.1 client credentials grant, cached until shortly before they
  16 * expire. Enough for scripts and the demo; a Spring application should use Spring
  17 * Security's OAuth 2.0 client instead, as the agent does.
  18 */
  19public class ClientCredentials implements Supplier<String> {
  20
  21    private final RestClient http = RestClient.create();
  22    private final URI tokenEndpoint;
  23    private final String clientId;
  24    private final String clientSecret;
  25    private final String scope;
  26    private String token;
  27    private Instant expiresAt = Instant.EPOCH;
  28
  29    public ClientCredentials(URI tokenEndpoint, String clientId, String clientSecret, String scope) {
  30        this.tokenEndpoint = tokenEndpoint;
  31        this.clientId = clientId;
  32        this.clientSecret = clientSecret;
  33        this.scope = scope;
  34    }
  35
  36    @Override
  37    public synchronized String get() {
  38        if (token == null || Instant.now().isAfter(expiresAt.minusSeconds(30))) {
  39            MultiValueMap<String, String> form = new LinkedMultiValueMap<>();
  40            form.add("grant_type", "client_credentials");
  41            form.add("scope", scope);
  42            JsonNode response = http.post().uri(tokenEndpoint)
  43                    .headers(headers -> headers.setBasicAuth(clientId, clientSecret))
  44                    .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_FORM_URLENCODED)
  45                    .body(form)
  46                    .retrieve()
  47                    .body(JsonNode.class);
  48            token = response.get("access_token").asString();
  49            expiresAt = Instant.now().plusSeconds(response.path("expires_in").asLong(60));
  50        }
  51        return token;
  52    }
  53}

   1package com.example.brokerage.client;
   2
   3import java.math.BigDecimal;
   4import java.net.URI;
   5import java.util.UUID;
   6
   7import com.example.brokerage.client.Model.Order;
   8import com.example.brokerage.client.Model.OrderTicket;
   9
  10import org.springframework.web.client.RestClient;
  11
  12/**
  13 * A guided tour of the API through the hypermedia client. Start the authorization server
  14 * and the API first, then run:
  15 *
  16 * <pre>
  17 *   ./mvnw -q -pl brokerage-client compile exec:java -Dexec.mainClass=com.example.brokerage.client.Demo
  18 * </pre>
  19 */
  20public final class Demo {
  21
  22    public static void main(String[] args) throws InterruptedException {
  23        ClientCredentials tokens = new ClientCredentials(URI.create("http://localhost:9000/oauth2/token"),
  24                "brokerage-cli", "cli-secret", "accounts:read market-data:read orders:read orders:write");
  25        HypermediaClient http = new HypermediaClient(RestClient.builder()
  26                .requestInterceptor((request, body, execution) -> {
  27                    request.getHeaders().setBearerAuth(tokens.get());
  28                    return execution.execute(request, body);
  29                }));
  30        BrokerageClient brokerage = new BrokerageClient(http, URI.create("http://localhost:8080/"));
  31
  32        System.out.println("Accounts");
  33        brokerage.accounts().forEach(account -> System.out.printf("  %-9s %-18s %s%n",
  34                account.id(), account.nickname(), account.type()));
  35
  36        var balances = brokerage.balances("ACC-1001");
  37        System.out.printf("%nACC-1001: cash %s, buying power %s, equity %s%n",
  38                balances.cash(), balances.buyingPower(), balances.totalEquity());
  39
  40        System.out.println("\nPositions");
  41        brokerage.positions("ACC-1001").forEach(p -> System.out.printf("  %-5s %6s @ %-9s P&L %s%n",
  42                p.symbol(), p.quantity(), p.lastPrice(), p.unrealizedPnl()));
  43
  44        var quote = brokerage.quote("AAPL");
  45        System.out.printf("%nAAPL %s  bid %s  ask %s  (%s%%)%n",
  46                quote.last(), quote.bid().price(), quote.ask().price(), quote.changePercent());
  47
  48        // A limit order well below the market, so that it rests and can be canceled.
  49        BigDecimal price = quote.last().multiply(new BigDecimal("0.90"))
  50                .setScale(2, java.math.RoundingMode.DOWN);
  51        OrderTicket ticket = OrderTicket.limit("EQ-AAPL", "BUY", new BigDecimal("5"), price);
  52        var preview = brokerage.preview("ACC-1001", ticket);
  53        System.out.printf("%nPreview: 5 AAPL at %s costs %s (acceptable: %s)%n",
  54                price, preview.estimatedTotal(), preview.acceptable());
  55
  56        Order order = brokerage.place("ACC-1001", ticket, UUID.randomUUID().toString());
  57        System.out.printf("Placed %s: %s, cancelable: %s%n", order.id(), order.status(),
  58                order.isCancellable());
  59
  60        order = brokerage.cancel(order);
  61        System.out.printf("Cancel requested: %s%n", order.status());
  62        while (order.isCancellable() || "PENDING_CANCEL".equals(order.status())) {
  63            Thread.sleep(500);
  64            order = brokerage.refresh(order);
  65        }
  66        System.out.printf("Now %s, cancelable: %s%n", order.status(), order.isCancellable());
  67    }
  68
  69    private Demo() {
  70    }
  71}

   1package com.example.brokerage.client;
   2
   3import java.util.ArrayList;
   4import java.util.List;
   5import java.util.Optional;
   6
   7import tools.jackson.databind.JsonNode;
   8import tools.jackson.databind.json.JsonMapper;
   9
  10import org.springframework.hateoas.Link;
  11import org.springframework.http.HttpHeaders;
  12
  13/**
  14 * A HAL representation as a client sees it: properties, links by relation, embedded
  15 * resources, and the response headers that came with it.
  16 */
  17public final class HalResource {
  18
  19    private final JsonNode body;
  20    private final HttpHeaders headers;
  21    private final JsonMapper json;
  22
  23    HalResource(JsonNode body, HttpHeaders headers, JsonMapper json) {
  24        this.body = body;
  25        this.headers = headers;
  26        this.json = json;
  27    }
  28
  29    /** The first link with this relation, if the server offered one. */
  30    public Optional<Link> link(String rel) {
  31        return links(rel).stream().findFirst();
  32    }
  33
  34    /** The link with this relation; its absence means the action is not available now. */
  35    public Link requiredLink(String rel) {
  36        return link(rel).orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalStateException(
  37                "The server offered no '" + rel + "' link, so that action is not available"));
  38    }
  39
  40    /** Every link with this relation. HAL sends one link as an object, several as an array. */
  41    public List<Link> links(String rel) {
  42        JsonNode node = body.path("_links").path(rel);
  43        List<Link> links = new ArrayList<>();
  44        for (JsonNode each : node.isArray() ? node : List.of(node)) {
  45            if (each.hasNonNull("href")) {
  46                Link link = Link.of(each.get("href").asString(), rel);
  47                links.add(each.hasNonNull("name") ? link.withName(each.get("name").asString()) : link);
  48            }
  49        }
  50        return links;
  51    }
  52
  53    /** Resources embedded under a relation, such as the items of a collection. */
  54    public List<HalResource> embedded(String rel) {
  55        List<HalResource> items = new ArrayList<>();
  56        body.path("_embedded").path(rel)
  57                .forEach(item -> items.add(new HalResource(item, new HttpHeaders(), json)));
  58        return items;
  59    }
  60
  61    /** The properties as a Java type. Unknown properties are ignored: a tolerant reader. */
  62    public <T> T as(Class<T> type) {
  63        return json.treeToValue(body, type);
  64    }
  65
  66    public String etag() {
  67        return headers.getETag();
  68    }
  69
  70    public HttpHeaders headers() {
  71        return headers;
  72    }
  73
  74    public JsonNode body() {
  75        return body;
  76    }
  77}

   1package com.example.brokerage.client;
   2
   3import java.math.BigDecimal;
   4import java.net.URI;
   5import java.util.function.Consumer;
   6
   7import com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonFormat;
   8import com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonInclude;
   9import tools.jackson.databind.DeserializationFeature;
  10import tools.jackson.databind.json.JsonMapper;
  11
  12import org.springframework.hateoas.Link;
  13import org.springframework.http.HttpHeaders;
  14import org.springframework.http.HttpStatusCode;
  15import org.springframework.http.MediaType;
  16import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
  17import org.springframework.web.client.RestClient;
  18
  19/**
  20 * HTTP for hypermedia: every request targets a link the server provided. There is no
  21 * method that takes a path to append to a base URL, by design.
  22 */
  23public class HypermediaClient {
  24
  25    public static final MediaType HAL_JSON = MediaType.parseMediaType("application/hal+json");
  26    public static final MediaType MERGE_PATCH = MediaType.parseMediaType("application/merge-patch+json");
  27
  28    private final RestClient http;
  29    private final JsonMapper json;
  30
  31    public HypermediaClient(RestClient.Builder builder) {
  32        this.json = JsonMapper.builder()
  33                // Tolerant reader: new properties on the server must never break this client.
  34                .disable(DeserializationFeature.FAIL_ON_UNKNOWN_PROPERTIES)
  35                // The API's convention: decimals are strings, and absent fields are omitted.
  36                .withConfigOverride(BigDecimal.class,
  37                        o -> o.setFormat(JsonFormat.Value.forShape(JsonFormat.Shape.STRING)))
  38                .changeDefaultPropertyInclusion(i -> i.withValueInclusion(JsonInclude.Include.NON_NULL))
  39                .build();
  40        this.http = builder
  41                .defaultHeader(HttpHeaders.ACCEPT, HAL_JSON + ", application/problem+json")
  42                // Pin the API version on every request, so a new default can never change
  43                // what this client receives.
  44                .defaultHeader("API-Version", "2")
  45                .defaultStatusHandler(HttpStatusCode::isError, (request, response) -> {
  46                    throw ApiProblem.from(response, json);
  47                })
  48                .build();
  49    }
  50
  51    public HalResource get(URI target) {
  52        return get(target, headers -> { });
  53    }
  54
  55    public HalResource get(URI target, Consumer<HttpHeaders> headers) {
  56        return read(http.get().uri(target).headers(headers).retrieve().toEntity(String.class));
  57    }
  58
  59    public HalResource post(Link target, Object body, Consumer<HttpHeaders> headers) {
  60        RestClient.RequestBodySpec request = http.post().uri(target.toUri()).headers(headers);
  61        if (body != null) {
  62            request.contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).body(json.writeValueAsString(body));
  63        }
  64        return read(request.retrieve().toEntity(String.class));
  65    }
  66
  67    /** A JSON merge patch, sent only if the resource still has the ETag the caller read. */
  68    public HalResource patch(Link target, Object changes, String ifMatch) {
  69        return read(http.patch().uri(target.toUri())
  70                .contentType(MERGE_PATCH)
  71                .header(HttpHeaders.IF_MATCH, ifMatch)
  72                .body(json.writeValueAsString(changes))
  73                .retrieve().toEntity(String.class));
  74    }
  75
  76    private HalResource read(ResponseEntity<String> response) {
  77        String body = response.getBody();
  78        return new HalResource(json.readTree(body == null ? "{}" : body), response.getHeaders(), json);
  79    }
  80}

   1package com.example.brokerage.client;

   3import java.math.BigDecimal;

   9import com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonProperty;
  10import tools.jackson.databind.JsonNode;
  11
  12/**
  13 * The client's view of the API's representations: only the fields it uses. Enumerations
  14 * are read as strings, so a status the server adds next year cannot break this client.
  15 */
  16public final class Model {
  17
  18    private Model() {
  19    }
  20
  21    public record Account(String id, String nickname, String type, String registration, String currency) {
  22    }
  23
  24    public record Balances(String currency, BigDecimal cash, BigDecimal reservedForOrders,
  25            BigDecimal buyingPower, BigDecimal positionsMarketValue, BigDecimal totalEquity,
  26            BigDecimal unrealizedPnl) {
  27    }
  28
  29    public record Position(String instrumentId, String symbol, BigDecimal quantity, BigDecimal averageCost,
  30            BigDecimal lastPrice, BigDecimal marketValue, BigDecimal unrealizedPnl,
  31            BigDecimal unrealizedPnlPercent) {
  32    }
  33
  34    public record Instrument(String id, String symbol, String name, String type, boolean tradable) {
  35    }
  36
  37    /** A quote, as served by API version 2. */
  38    public record Quote(String symbol, BigDecimal last, PriceLevel bid, PriceLevel ask, BigDecimal change,
  39            BigDecimal changePercent, Instant asOf) {
  40
  41        public record PriceLevel(BigDecimal price, BigDecimal size) {
  42        }
  43    }
  44
  45    /** What to trade: the body of a preview or a new order. */
  46    public record OrderTicket(String instrumentId, String side, String type, BigDecimal quantity,
  47            BigDecimal limitPrice, String timeInForce, String clientOrderId) {
  48
  49        public static OrderTicket market(String instrumentId, String side, BigDecimal quantity) {
  50            return new OrderTicket(instrumentId, side, "MARKET", quantity, null, "DAY", null);
  51        }
  52
  53        public static OrderTicket limit(String instrumentId, String side, BigDecimal quantity,
  54                BigDecimal price) {
  55            return new OrderTicket(instrumentId, side, "LIMIT", quantity, price, "DAY", null);
  56        }
  57    }
  58
  59    public record OrderPreview(String symbol, BigDecimal estimatedPrice, BigDecimal estimatedTotal,
  60            BigDecimal buyingPower, boolean acceptable, List<Issue> issues) {
  61
  62        public record Issue(String type, String detail) {
  63        }
  64    }
  65
  66    /** An order, with the links the server offered for it at the time it was read. */
  67    public record Order(String id, String symbol, String side, String type, BigDecimal quantity,
  68            BigDecimal limitPrice, String status, BigDecimal filledQuantity, BigDecimal averageFillPrice,
  69            Instant createdAt, @JsonProperty("_links") JsonNode links) {
  70
  71        public URI self() {
  72            return link("self").orElseThrow();
  73        }
  74
  75        /** Present only while the server allows the action it names. */
  76        public Optional<URI> link(String rel) {
  77            JsonNode href = links == null ? null : links.path(rel).path("href");
  78            return href == null || href.isMissingNode() ? Optional.empty()
  79                    : Optional.of(URI.create(href.asString()));
  80        }
  81
  82        public boolean isCancellable() {
  83            return link("bk:cancel").isPresent();
  84        }
  85    }
  86}

  90                         "_links": {"self": {"href": "https://api.test/a/1/o/9"}}}"""));

  92        OrderTicket ticket = OrderTicket.market("EQ-X", "BUY", new BigDecimal("5"));
