   1package com.example.brokerage.agent;
   2
   3import java.io.BufferedReader;
   4import java.io.IOException;
   5import java.io.InputStreamReader;
   6import java.util.UUID;
   7
   8import org.springframework.ai.chat.client.ChatClient;
   9import org.springframework.ai.chat.memory.ChatMemory;
  10import org.springframework.ai.chat.model.ChatResponse;
  11import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;
  12import org.springframework.boot.CommandLineRunner;
  13import org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.condition.ConditionalOnBooleanProperty;
  14import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
  15
  16/**
  17 * A console conversation. Lines starting with "/" are commands handled here, by code, and
  18 * never reach the model: that is what makes "/confirm" a human decision.
  19 */
  20@Component
  21@ConditionalOnBooleanProperty(name = "brokerage.console.enabled", matchIfMissing = true)
  22class AgentConsole implements CommandLineRunner {
  23
  24    private final ChatClient chat;
  25    private final PendingActions pending;
  26    private final BrokerageTools tools;
  27    private final boolean modelConfigured;
  28    private final String conversation = UUID.randomUUID().toString();
  29
  30    AgentConsole(ChatClient chat, PendingActions pending, BrokerageTools tools,
  31            @Value("${spring.ai.anthropic.api-key:}") String apiKey) {
  32        this.chat = chat;
  33        this.pending = pending;
  34        this.tools = tools;
  35        this.modelConfigured = !apiKey.isBlank();
  36    }
  37
  38    @Override
  39    public void run(String... args) throws IOException {
  40        System.out.println("Brokerage assistant. Ask about your accounts or ask for a trade.");
  41        System.out.println("Commands: /confirm CODE, /discard CODE, /status, /quit");
  42        BufferedReader in = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
  43        for (String line; (line = prompt(in)) != null && !line.equals("/quit"); ) {
  44            if (line.startsWith("/confirm ")) {
  45                System.out.println(pending.confirm(line.substring(9).trim()));
  46            } else if (line.startsWith("/discard ")) {
  47                boolean discarded = pending.discard(line.substring(9).trim());
  48                System.out.println(discarded ? "Discarded." : "Nothing to discard.");
  49            } else if (line.equals("/status")) {
  50                // The tools are plain Java: call one directly to check the API and the token,
  51                // with no model involved.
  52                tools.listAccounts()
  53                        .forEach(account -> System.out.println(account.id() + "  " + account.nickname()));
  54            } else if (!line.isBlank()) {
  55                System.out.println(modelConfigured ? ask(line)
  56                        : "Set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY to talk to the assistant.");
  57            }
  58        }
  59    }
  60
  61    private String ask(String question) {
  62        ChatResponse response = chat.prompt()
  63                .user(question)
  64                .advisors(advisor -> advisor.param(ChatMemory.CONVERSATION_ID, conversation))
  65                .call()
  66                .chatResponse();
  67        // Check why the model stopped before reading its text: a refusal has no answer to show.
  68        String finish = response.getResult().getMetadata().getFinishReason();
  69        if ("refusal".equalsIgnoreCase(finish)) {
  70            return "The assistant declined that request. Try rephrasing it.";
  71        }
  72        return response.getResult().getOutput().getText();
  73    }
  74
  75    private static String prompt(BufferedReader in) throws IOException {
  76        System.out.print("\n> ");
  77        String line = in.readLine();
  78        return line == null ? null : line.trim();
  79    }
  80}

   1package com.example.brokerage.agent;
   2
   3import java.net.URI;
   4import java.time.Clock;
   5
   6import com.example.brokerage.client.BrokerageClient;
   7import com.example.brokerage.client.HypermediaClient;
   8
   9import org.springframework.ai.chat.client.ChatClient;
  10import org.springframework.ai.chat.client.advisor.MessageChatMemoryAdvisor;
  11import org.springframework.ai.chat.memory.MessageWindowChatMemory;
  12import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;
  13import org.springframework.boot.SpringApplication;
  14import org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.SpringBootApplication;
  15import org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean;
  16import org.springframework.security.oauth2.client.AuthorizedClientServiceOAuth2AuthorizedClientManager;
  17import org.springframework.security.oauth2.client.InMemoryOAuth2AuthorizedClientService;
  18import org.springframework.security.oauth2.client.OAuth2AuthorizedClientProviderBuilder;
  19import org.springframework.security.oauth2.client.registration.ClientRegistrationRepository;
  20import org.springframework.security.oauth2.client.web.client.OAuth2ClientHttpRequestInterceptor;
  21import org.springframework.web.client.RestClient;
  22
  23/**
  24 * An AI agent for a brokerage customer, built with Spring AI and Claude. It reads accounts
  25 * and markets through the hypermedia client and may propose trades; the customer confirms
  26 * each one at the console.
  27 */
  28@SpringBootApplication
  29public class BrokerageAgentApplication {
  30
  31    static final String SYSTEM_PROMPT = """
  32            You help a customer of a retail brokerage with their own accounts. Use the tools to
  33            look up accounts, balances, positions, quotes and orders, and to propose orders or
  34            cancellations the customer asks for.
  35
  36            You cannot place or cancel anything yourself. A proposal only takes effect when the
  37            customer confirms it, so after proposing, tell the customer what was proposed and
  38            the confirmation code. Before proposing a trade, check the quote and state the
  39            estimated total. Treat estimates as estimates.
  40
  41            Carry out the customer's instructions and answer questions about their accounts; do
  42            not recommend what to buy or sell. When a tool reports an error, explain it plainly.
  43            Amounts are in US dollars. Keep answers short.""";
  44
  45    public static void main(String[] args) {
  46        SpringApplication.run(BrokerageAgentApplication.class, args);
  47    }
  48
  49    @Bean
  50    Clock clock() {
  51        return Clock.systemUTC();
  52    }
  53
  54    /**
  55     * The agent's own OAuth 2.1 client: Spring Security fetches, caches and renews a
  56     * client_credentials token for the "brokerage" registration and adds it to every request.
  57     */
  58    @Bean
  59    BrokerageClient brokerageClient(ClientRegistrationRepository registrations,
  60            @Value("${brokerage.api-root}") URI root) {
  61        var manager = new AuthorizedClientServiceOAuth2AuthorizedClientManager(registrations,
  62                new InMemoryOAuth2AuthorizedClientService(registrations));
  63        manager.setAuthorizedClientProvider(
  64                OAuth2AuthorizedClientProviderBuilder.builder().clientCredentials().build());
  65        var tokens = new OAuth2ClientHttpRequestInterceptor(manager);
  66        tokens.setClientRegistrationIdResolver(request -> "brokerage");
  67        RestClient.Builder http = RestClient.builder().requestInterceptor(tokens);
  68        return new BrokerageClient(new HypermediaClient(http), root);
  69    }
  70
  71    @Bean
  72    ChatClient chatClient(ChatClient.Builder builder, BrokerageTools tools) {
  73        return builder
  74                .defaultSystem(SYSTEM_PROMPT)
  75                .defaultTools(tools)
  76                .defaultAdvisors(
  77                        MessageChatMemoryAdvisor.builder(MessageWindowChatMemory.builder().build()).build())
  78                .build();
  79    }
  80}

   1package com.example.brokerage.agent;
   2
   3import java.math.BigDecimal;
   4import java.util.List;
   5
   6import com.example.brokerage.agent.PendingActions.Proposal;
   7import com.example.brokerage.client.BrokerageClient;
   8import com.example.brokerage.client.Model.Account;
   9import com.example.brokerage.client.Model.Balances;
  10import com.example.brokerage.client.Model.Order;
  11import com.example.brokerage.client.Model.OrderPreview;
  12import com.example.brokerage.client.Model.OrderTicket;
  13import com.example.brokerage.client.Model.Position;
  14import com.example.brokerage.client.Model.Quote;
  15
  16import org.springframework.ai.tool.annotation.Tool;
  17import org.springframework.ai.tool.annotation.ToolParam;
  18import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
  19
  20/**
  21 * The agent's tools. Each is a thin wrapper over the hypermedia client, so the model sees
  22 * exactly what the API allows, and every rule is still enforced by the API itself.
  23 * Read tools act immediately; tools that would change anything only create proposals.
  24 */
  25@Component
  26public class BrokerageTools {
  27
  28    private final BrokerageClient brokerage;
  29    private final PendingActions pending;
  30
  31    public BrokerageTools(BrokerageClient brokerage, PendingActions pending) {
  32        this.brokerage = brokerage;
  33        this.pending = pending;
  34    }
  35
  36    @Tool(description = "List the customer's brokerage accounts: ID, nickname, type and currency.")
  37    public List<Account> listAccounts() {
  38        return brokerage.accounts();
  39    }
  40
  41    @Tool(description = "Cash, cash reserved for open orders, buying power and total equity of one account.")
  42    public Balances getBalances(@ToolParam(description = "Account ID, such as ACC-1001") String accountId) {
  43        return brokerage.balances(accountId);
  44    }
  45
  46    @Tool(description = "Holdings of one account with quantity, average cost, market value and "
  47            + "unrealized P&L.")
  48    public List<Position> getPositions(@ToolParam(description = "Account ID") String accountId) {
  49        return brokerage.positions(accountId);
  50    }
  51
  52    @Tool(description = "The latest quote for a stock or ETF: last price, bid, ask and change on the day.")
  53    public Quote getQuote(@ToolParam(description = "Ticker symbol, such as AAPL") String symbol) {
  54        return brokerage.quote(symbol);
  55    }
  56
  57    @Tool(description = "Orders in one account that are still working (open or partially filled).")
  58    public List<Order> getOpenOrders(@ToolParam(description = "Account ID") String accountId) {
  59        return brokerage.openOrders(accountId);
  60    }
  61
  62    @Tool(description = """
  63            Propose an order for the customer to confirm. The brokerage checks it first and the
  64            estimate is returned. Nothing is placed until the customer confirms the proposal.""")
  65    public Object proposeOrder(@ToolParam(description = "Account ID") String accountId,
  66            @ToolParam(description = "Ticker symbol") String symbol,
  67            @ToolParam(description = "BUY or SELL") String side,
  68            @ToolParam(description = "Number of shares, as a decimal string such as \"10\"") String quantity,
  69            @ToolParam(description = "Limit price as a decimal string; omit for a market order",
  70                    required = false) String limitPrice) {
  71        String instrumentId = brokerage.instrument(symbol).id();
  72        BigDecimal shares = new BigDecimal(quantity);
  73        OrderTicket ticket = limitPrice == null || limitPrice.isBlank()
  74                ? OrderTicket.market(instrumentId, side, shares)
  75                : OrderTicket.limit(instrumentId, side, shares, new BigDecimal(limitPrice));
  76        OrderPreview preview = brokerage.preview(accountId, ticket);
  77        if (!preview.acceptable()) {
  78            return preview; // the issues explain why; nothing to confirm
  79        }
  80        String price = ticket.limitPrice() == null ? "at market" : "limit " + ticket.limitPrice();
  81        String summary = "%s %s %s in %s, %s, estimated total %s USD".formatted(side, quantity, symbol,
  82                accountId, price, preview.estimatedTotal());
  83        return pending.propose(summary, idempotencyKey -> {
  84            Order order = brokerage.place(accountId, ticket, idempotencyKey);
  85            return "Placed order " + order.id() + ": " + order.status();
  86        });
  87    }
  88
  89    @Tool(description = "Propose canceling a working order. "
  90            + "Nothing is canceled until the customer confirms.")
  91    public Proposal proposeCancellation(@ToolParam(description = "Account ID") String accountId,
  92            @ToolParam(description = "Order ID, such as ORD-100002") String orderId) {
  93        Order order = brokerage.openOrders(accountId).stream()
  94                .filter(open -> open.id().equals(orderId))
  95                .findFirst()
  96                .orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalArgumentException(
  97                        "No working order " + orderId + " in " + accountId));
  98        String summary = "Cancel " + order.side() + " " + order.quantity() + " " + order.symbol()
  99                + " (" + orderId + ")";
 100        return pending.propose(summary,
 101                ignored -> "Cancellation requested: " + brokerage.cancel(order).status());
 102    }
 103}

brokerage-agent/src/main/java/com/example/brokerage/agent/PendingActions.java65 lines

   1package com.example.brokerage.agent;
   2
   3import java.time.Clock;
   4import java.time.Duration;
   5import java.time.Instant;
   6import java.util.Locale;
   7import java.util.Map;
   8import java.util.UUID;
   9import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
  10import java.util.function.Function;
  11
  12import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
  13
  14/**
  15 * The human-in-the-loop gate. The model can only propose a trade; carrying it out takes a
  16 * person typing "/confirm CODE" at the console, a path that no tool can reach.
  17 *
  18 * <p>The confirmation code doubles as the order's Idempotency-Key, so confirming the same
  19 * proposal twice, or retrying after a timeout, can never place a second order.
  20 */
  21@Component
  22public class PendingActions {
  23
  24    /** What the model is told about a proposal: enough to ask the customer, nothing to act on. */
  25    public record Proposal(String code, String summary, Instant expiresAt, String instructions) {
  26    }
  27
  28    private record Pending(Proposal proposal, Function<String, String> action) {
  29    }
  30
  31    static final Duration LIFETIME = Duration.ofMinutes(5);
  32
  33    private final Map<String, Pending> pending = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
  34    private final Clock clock;
  35
  36    public PendingActions(Clock clock) {
  37        this.clock = clock;
  38    }
  39
  40    /** Records an action to run later. The action receives the code to use as its Idempotency-Key. */
  41    public Proposal propose(String summary, Function<String, String> action) {
  42        String code = UUID.randomUUID().toString().substring(0, 8).toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);
  43        Proposal proposal = new Proposal(code, summary, clock.instant().plus(LIFETIME),
  44                "Nothing has been done yet. Ask the customer to type /confirm " + code
  45                        + " to go ahead, or /discard " + code + " to drop it. It expires in 5 minutes.");
  46        pending.put(code, new Pending(proposal, action));
  47        return proposal;
  48    }
  49
  50    /** Called only from the console, when a person types /confirm CODE. */
  51    public String confirm(String code) {
  52        Pending action = pending.remove(code.toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT));
  53        if (action == null) {
  54            return "There is no pending action " + code + ".";
  55        }
  56        if (clock.instant().isAfter(action.proposal().expiresAt())) {
  57            return "Proposal " + code + " expired; ask the assistant again.";
  58        }
  59        return action.action().apply(action.proposal().code());
  60    }
  61
  62    public boolean discard(String code) {
  63        return pending.remove(code.toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT)) != null;
  64    }
  65}

   1package com.example.brokerage.agent;
   2
   3import java.io.IOException;
   4
   5import okhttp3.Interceptor;
   6import okhttp3.MediaType;
   7import okhttp3.Request;
   8import okhttp3.RequestBody;
   9import okhttp3.Response;
  10import okio.Buffer;
  11import tools.jackson.databind.json.JsonMapper;
  12import tools.jackson.databind.node.ObjectNode;
  13
  14import org.springframework.ai.anthropic.http.okhttp.AnthropicHttpClientBuilderCustomizer;
  15import org.springframework.ai.anthropic.http.okhttp.SpringAiAnthropicHttpClient;
  16import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
  17
  18/**
  19 * Opts every Messages API request into server-side refusal fallbacks: if a safety
  20 * classifier declines a request, the API re-runs it on the fallback model Anthropic
  21 * recommends for that category instead of returning the refusal. Spring AI has no option
  22 * for this request field, so it is added at the HTTP layer.
  23 */
  24@Component
  25class RefusalFallbacks implements AnthropicHttpClientBuilderCustomizer, Interceptor {
  26
  27    static final String BETA = "server-side-fallback-2026-07-01";
  28    private static final JsonMapper JSON = JsonMapper.builder().build();
  29
  30    @Override
  31    public void customize(SpringAiAnthropicHttpClient.Builder builder) {
  32        builder.interceptor(this);
  33    }
  34
  35    @Override
  36    public Response intercept(Chain chain) throws IOException {
  37        Request request = chain.request();
  38        if (!"POST".equals(request.method()) || !request.url().encodedPath().endsWith("/v1/messages")
  39                || request.body() == null) {
  40            return chain.proceed(request);
  41        }
  42        Buffer body = new Buffer();
  43        request.body().writeTo(body);
  44        MediaType type = request.body().contentType();
  45        String existing = request.header("anthropic-beta");
  46        return chain.proceed(request.newBuilder()
  47                .header("anthropic-beta", existing == null ? BETA : existing + "," + BETA)
  48                .post(RequestBody.create(withFallbacks(body.readUtf8()), type))
  49                .build());
  50    }
  51
  52    /** The request body with "fallbacks": "default" added. */
  53    static String withFallbacks(String json) {
  54        ObjectNode request = (ObjectNode) JSON.readTree(json);
  55        request.put("fallbacks", "default");
  56        return JSON.writeValueAsString(request);
  57    }
  58}

  35    static final MediaType HAL = MediaType.parseMediaType("application/hal+json");
  36    static final String ROOT = """
  37            {"_links": {"self": {"href": "http://api/"}, "bk:accounts": {"href": "http://api/accounts"},
  38              "bk:instruments": {"href": "http://api/instruments{?symbol,type}", "templated": true}}}""";
  39    static final String ACCOUNTS = """
  40            {"_embedded": {"bk:accounts": [{"id": "ACC-1001", "nickname": "Main", "type": "MARGIN",
  41              "_links": {"self": {"href": "http://api/accounts/ACC-1001"},
  42                "bk:orders": {"href": "http://api/accounts/ACC-1001/orders{?status,symbol,cursor,limit}",
  43                              "templated": true},
  44                "bk:order-previews": {"href": "http://api/accounts/ACC-1001/order-previews"}}}]}}""";
  45    static final String AAPL = """
  46            {"_embedded": {"bk:instruments": [{"id": "EQ-AAPL", "symbol": "AAPL", "name": "Apple Inc.",
  47              "type": "EQUITY", "tradable": true,
  48              "_links": {"self": {"href": "http://api/instruments/EQ-AAPL"}}}]}}""";
  49
  50    MockRestServiceServer api;
  51    PendingActions pending;
  52    BrokerageTools tools;
  53
  54    @BeforeEach
  55    void setUp() {
  56        RestClient.Builder builder = RestClient.builder();
  57        api = MockRestServiceServer.bindTo(builder).build();
  58        pending = new PendingActions(Clock.systemUTC());
  59        var brokerage = new BrokerageClient(new HypermediaClient(builder), URI.create("http://api/"));
  60        tools = new BrokerageTools(brokerage, pending);
  61    }
  62
  63    @Test
  64    void theModelSeesSevenToolsWithDescribedParameters() {
  65        ToolCallback[] callbacks = ToolCallbacks.from(tools);
  66        assertThat(Arrays.stream(callbacks).map(callback -> callback.getToolDefinition().name()))
  67                .containsExactlyInAnyOrder("listAccounts", "getBalances", "getPositions", "getQuote",
  68                        "getOpenOrders", "proposeOrder", "proposeCancellation");
  69        String proposeOrder = Arrays.stream(callbacks)
  70                .filter(callback -> callback.getToolDefinition().name().equals("proposeOrder"))
  71                .findFirst().orElseThrow().getToolDefinition().inputSchema();
  72        assertThat(proposeOrder).contains("\"required\"").contains("\"quantity\"").contains("decimal string");
  73    }
  74
  75    @Test
  76    void proposingPlacesNothingAndConfirmingPlacesExactlyOnce() {
  77        expect("http://api/", ROOT);                           // symbol -> instrument
  78        expect("http://api/instruments?symbol=AAPL", AAPL);
  79        expect("http://api/", ROOT);                           // account -> its previews link
  80        expect("http://api/accounts", ACCOUNTS);
  81        api.expect(ExpectedCount.once(), requestTo("http://api/accounts/ACC-1001/order-previews"))
  82                .andExpect(method(HttpMethod.POST))
  83                .andRespond(withSuccess("""
  84                        {"symbol": "AAPL", "estimatedPrice": "232.42", "estimatedTotal": "2324.20",
  85                         "buyingPower": "55241.10", "acceptable": true, "issues": []}""", HAL));
  86
  87        Object result = tools.proposeOrder("ACC-1001", "AAPL", "BUY", "10", null);
  88
  89        assertThat(result).isInstanceOf(Proposal.class);
  90        Proposal proposal = (Proposal) result;
  91        assertThat(proposal.summary()).contains("BUY 10 AAPL").contains("2324.20");
  92        api.verify(); // a preview, and no order
  93
  94        api.reset();
  95        expect("http://api/", ROOT);
  96        expect("http://api/accounts", ACCOUNTS);
  97        api.expect(ExpectedCount.once(), requestTo("http://api/accounts/ACC-1001/orders"))
  98                .andExpect(method(HttpMethod.POST))
  99                .andExpect(header("Idempotency-Key", proposal.code()))
 100                .andRespond(withStatus(HttpStatus.CREATED).contentType(HAL).body("""
 101                        {"id": "ORD-100009", "status": "OPEN",
 102                         "_links": {"self": {"href": "http://api/accounts/ACC-1001/orders/ORD-100009"}}}"""));
 103
 104        assertThat(pending.confirm(proposal.code())).isEqualTo("Placed order ORD-100009: OPEN");
 105        assertThat(pending.confirm(proposal.code())).startsWith("There is no pending action");
 106        api.verify();
 107    }
 108
 109    @Test
 110    void anUnacceptablePreviewIsReturnedWithoutAProposal() {
 111        expect("http://api/", ROOT);                           // symbol -> instrument
 112        expect("http://api/instruments?symbol=AAPL", AAPL);
 113        expect("http://api/", ROOT);                           // account -> its previews link
 114        expect("http://api/accounts", ACCOUNTS);
 115        api.expect(requestTo("http://api/accounts/ACC-1001/order-previews")).andRespond(withSuccess("""
 116                {"symbol": "AAPL", "acceptable": false, "issues": [{"type":
 117                  "https://docs.brokerage.example/problems/insufficient-buying-power",
 118                  "detail": "This order needs 2324200.00 but only 55241.10 is available"}]}""", HAL));
 119
 120        Object result = tools.proposeOrder("ACC-1001", "AAPL", "BUY", "10000", null);
 121
 122        assertThat(result).isNotInstanceOf(Proposal.class);
 123        assertThat(result.toString()).contains("insufficient-buying-power");
 124    }
 125
 126    private void expect(String url, String body) {
 127        api.expect(ExpectedCount.once(), requestTo(url)).andExpect(method(HttpMethod.GET))
 128                .andRespond(withSuccess(body, HAL));
 129    }
 130}

brokerage-agent/src/test/java/com/example/brokerage/agent/GuardrailsTest.java81 lines

   1package com.example.brokerage.agent;
   2
   3import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
   4
   5import java.time.Clock;
   6import java.time.Instant;
   7import java.time.ZoneOffset;
   8import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger;
   9
  10import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
  11
  12/**
  13 * Proposals expire, can be discarded, and run at most once; every Messages API request is
  14 * opted into server-side refusal fallbacks.
  15 */
  16class GuardrailsTest {
  17
  18    @Test
  19    void anExpiredProposalIsNotCarriedOut() {
  20        MutableClock clock = new MutableClock();
  21        PendingActions pending = new PendingActions(clock);
  22        AtomicInteger runs = new AtomicInteger();
  23        var proposal = pending.propose("Buy 1 AAPL", key -> "ran " + runs.incrementAndGet());
  24
  25        clock.advanceSeconds(301);
  26
  27        assertThat(pending.confirm(proposal.code())).contains("expired");
  28        assertThat(runs).hasValue(0);
  29    }
  30
  31    @Test
  32    void aDiscardedProposalCannotBeConfirmed() {
  33        PendingActions pending = new PendingActions(Clock.systemUTC());
  34        var proposal = pending.propose("Sell 1 MSFT", key -> "ran");
  35
  36        assertThat(pending.discard(proposal.code())).isTrue();
  37        assertThat(pending.confirm(proposal.code())).startsWith("There is no pending action");
  38    }
  39
  40    @Test
  41    void theConfirmationCodeIsTheIdempotencyKey() {
  42        PendingActions pending = new PendingActions(Clock.systemUTC());
  43        var proposal = pending.propose("Buy 1 AAPL", key -> key);
  44
  45        assertThat(pending.confirm(proposal.code().toLowerCase())).isEqualTo(proposal.code());
  46    }
  47
  48    @Test
  49    void everyMessagesRequestAsksForServerSideFallbacks() {
  50        String request = "{\"model\":\"claude-opus-5\",\"max_tokens\":16000,\"messages\":[]}";
  51
  52        assertThat(RefusalFallbacks.withFallbacks(request))
  53                .contains("\"fallbacks\":\"default\"")
  54                .contains("\"model\":\"claude-opus-5\"")
  55                .contains("\"max_tokens\":16000");
  56    }
  57
  58    /** A clock that tests can move forward. */
  59    static final class MutableClock extends Clock {
  60        private Instant now = Instant.parse("2026-09-28T15:00:00Z");
  61
  62        void advanceSeconds(long seconds) {
  63            now = now.plusSeconds(seconds);
  64        }
  65
  66        @Override
  67        public Instant instant() {
  68            return now;
  69        }
  70
  71        @Override
  72        public ZoneOffset getZone() {
  73            return ZoneOffset.UTC;
  74        }
  75
  76        @Override
  77        public Clock withZone(java.time.ZoneId zone) {
  78            return this;
  79        }
  80    }
  81}

   1openapi: 3.2.1
   2$self: https://api.brokerage.example/openapi.yaml
   3
   4info:
   5  title: Brokerage API
   6  version: "2.0"
   7  summary: Accounts, positions, market data and trading for a retail brokerage, as hypermedia.
   8  description: |
   9    A resource-oriented REST API that follows the standards in *REST API Standards with
  10    HATEOAS* (Smiroh Publishers).
  11
  12    * **Hypermedia.** Every representation is HAL (`application/hal+json`) with a `_links`
  13      object. Ask for `application/prs.hal-forms+json` to also receive `_templates`: the
  14      state transitions available right now. Clients should bookmark only the API root and
  15      follow links from there. Custom link relations use the CURIE `bk:`, which expands to
  16      `https://docs.brokerage.example/rels/{rel}`.
  17    * **Money.** Prices, amounts and quantities are decimal strings, never JSON numbers.
  18    * **Errors.** Every error is an RFC 9457 problem document (`application/problem+json`)
  19      whose `type` URI identifies the error. Branch on `type`, never on `title` or `detail`.
  20    * **Versions.** Send `API-Version: 2` to opt in to version 2. Version 1 is the default and
  21      is deprecated: its responses carry `Deprecation` (RFC 9745) and `Sunset` (RFC 8594).
  22    * **Quotas.** Every response carries `RateLimit-Policy` and `RateLimit`. Exceeding a quota
  23      returns 429 with `Retry-After`.
  24    * **Tracing.** Every response echoes `X-Request-Id`; quote it in support requests.

 428      tags: [order-events]
 429      security: [{ oauth2: [orders:read] }]
 430      parameters:
 431        - name: Last-Event-ID
 432          in: header
 433          schema: { type: integer, minimum: 0 }
 434      responses:
 435        "200":
 436          description: An unending stream of events.
 437          content:
 438            text/event-stream:
 439              itemSchema:
 440                type: object
 441                required: [id, event, data]
 442                properties:
 443                  id: { type: string }
 444                  event:
 445                    type: string
 446                    enum: [order.created, order.replaced, order.partially-filled, order.filled,
 447                      order.cancel-requested, order.cancelled]
 448                  data:
 449                    type: string
 450                    contentMediaType: application/json
 451                    contentSchema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/OrderEventData" }
 452        "404": { $ref: "#/components/responses/NotFound" }
 453
 454  /instruments:
 455    get:
 456      operationId: searchInstruments
 457      summary: Search instruments
 458      tags: [market-data]
 459      security: [{ oauth2: [market-data:read] }]
 460      parameters:
 461        - name: symbol
 462          in: query
 463          schema: { type: string, examples: [AAPL] }
 464        - name: type
 465          in: query
 466          schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/InstrumentType" }
 467      responses:
 468        "200":
 469          description: Matching instruments.
 470          content:
 471            application/hal+json:
 472              schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/InstrumentCollection" }
 473
 474  /instruments/{instrumentId}:
 475    parameters:
 476      - $ref: "#/components/parameters/instrumentId"
 477    get:
 478      operationId: getInstrument
 479      summary: Get an instrument
 480      tags: [market-data]
 481      security: [{ oauth2: [market-data:read] }]
 482      responses:
 483        "200":
 484          description: The instrument, with links to its quote and option chain or underlying.
 485          content:
 486            application/hal+json:
 487              schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Instrument" }
 488        "404": { $ref: "#/components/responses/NotFound" }
 489
 490  /instruments/{instrumentId}/quote:
 491    parameters:
 492      - $ref: "#/components/parameters/instrumentId"
 493    get:
 494      operationId: getQuote
 495      summary: Get a quote
 496      description: >-
 497        The shape depends on the API version: version 1 (the deprecated default) is flat;
 498        version 2 groups price and size into bid and ask levels and adds the day's change.
 499      tags: [market-data]
 500      security: [{ oauth2: [market-data:read] }]
 501      parameters:
 502        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/API-Version"
 503        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/If-None-Match"
 504      responses:
 505        "200":
 506          description: The latest quote. Cacheable privately for one second.
 507          headers:
 508            Cache-Control:
 509              schema: { type: string, examples: ["max-age=1, private"] }
 510            ETag: { $ref: "#/components/headers/ETag" }
 511            Deprecation: { $ref: "#/components/headers/Deprecation" }
 512            Sunset: { $ref: "#/components/headers/Sunset" }
 513          content:
 514            application/hal+json:
 515              schema:
 516                oneOf:
 517                  - $ref: "#/components/schemas/Quote"
 518                  - $ref: "#/components/schemas/QuoteV1"
 519        "304":
 520          description: The quote has not changed.
 521        "400": { $ref: "#/components/responses/BadRequest" }
 522        "404": { $ref: "#/components/responses/NotFound" }
 523
 524  /instruments/{instrumentId}/option-chain:
 525    parameters:
 526      - $ref: "#/components/parameters/instrumentId"
 527    get:
 528      operationId: getOptionChain
 529      summary: Get an option chain
 530      description: >-
 531        Contracts for one expiration (the nearest by default). Every available expiration is
 532        linked with the relation `bk:expiration`, named by its date.
 533      tags: [market-data]
 534      security: [{ oauth2: [market-data:read] }]
 535      parameters:
 536        - name: expiration
 537          in: query
 538          schema: { type: string, format: date }
 539      responses:
 540        "200":
 541          description: The option contracts.
 542          content:
 543            application/hal+json:
 544              schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/InstrumentCollection" }
 545        "404": { $ref: "#/components/responses/NotFound" }
 546
 547components:
 548  securitySchemes:
 549    oauth2:
 550      type: oauth2
 551      description: >-
 552        OAuth 2.1. Web apps sign customers in through their backend, a confidential client,
 553        with the authorization code grant and PKCE; a customer's own scripts and agents use
 554        client credentials registered to that customer. Tokens carry `customer_id` and, for
 555        delegated clients, `trading_limit`.
 556      oauth2MetadataUrl: http://localhost:9000/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server
 557      flows:
 558        authorizationCode:
 559          authorizationUrl: http://localhost:9000/oauth2/authorize
 560          tokenUrl: http://localhost:9000/oauth2/token
 561          refreshUrl: http://localhost:9000/oauth2/token
 562          scopes:
 563            market-data:read: Instruments, quotes and option chains
 564            accounts:read: Accounts, balances, positions and transactions
 565            orders:read: Orders, previews and order events
 566            orders:write: Place, change and cancel orders
 567        clientCredentials:
 568          tokenUrl: http://localhost:9000/oauth2/token
 569          scopes:
 570            market-data:read: Instruments, quotes and option chains
 571            accounts:read: Accounts, balances, positions and transactions
 572            orders:read: Orders, previews and order events
 573            orders:write: Place, change and cancel orders
 574
 575  parameters:
 576    accountId:
 577      name: accountId
 578      in: path
 579      required: true
 580      schema: { type: string, examples: [ACC-1001] }
 581    orderId:
 582      name: orderId
 583      in: path
 584      required: true
 585      schema: { type: string, examples: [ORD-100002] }
 586    instrumentId:
 587      name: instrumentId
 588      in: path
 589      required: true
 590      schema: { type: string, examples: [EQ-AAPL] }
 591    cursor:
 592      name: cursor
 593      in: query
 594      description: Opaque. Take it from a `next` link; never build one.
 595      schema: { type: string }
 596    limit:
 597      name: limit
 598      in: query
 599      schema: { type: integer, minimum: 1, maximum: 100, default: 25 }
 600    Idempotency-Key:
 601      name: Idempotency-Key
 602      in: header
 603      required: true
 604      description: A unique value per new order (a UUID works well). Retries reuse it.
 605      schema: { type: string, minLength: 1, maxLength: 255 }
 606    If-Match:
 607      name: If-Match
 608      in: header
 609      required: true
 610      description: The order's current ETag.
 611      schema: { type: string }
 612    If-None-Match:
 613      name: If-None-Match
 614      in: header
 615      description: An ETag from an earlier response; an unchanged resource returns 304.
 616      schema: { type: string }
 617    API-Version:
 618      name: API-Version
 619      in: header
 620      description: The API version to use. Defaults to 1 (deprecated).
 621      schema: { type: string, enum: ["1", "2"], default: "1" }
 622
 623  headers:
 624    X-Request-Id:
 625      description: The request's ID, echoed from the request or generated.
 626      schema: { type: string }
 627    Location:
 628      description: The URL of the resource created or affected.
 629      schema: { type: string, format: uri }
 630    ETag:
 631      description: The representation's entity tag.
 632      schema: { type: string }
 633    Idempotent-Replayed:
 634      description: true when the response replays an earlier request with the same Idempotency-Key.
 635      schema: { type: string, enum: ["true", "false"] }
 636    RateLimit:
 637      description: 'Remaining quota and seconds until reset, e.g. "default";r=117;t=42.'
 638      schema: { type: string }
 639    RateLimit-Policy:
 640      description: 'The quota policy, e.g. "default";q=120;w=60.'
 641      schema: { type: string }
 642    Retry-After:
 643      description: Seconds to wait before retrying.
 644      schema: { type: integer }
 645    Deprecation:
 646      description: When this version was deprecated (RFC 9745), e.g. @1788220800.
 647      schema: { type: string }
 648    Sunset:
 649      description: When this version stops working (RFC 8594).
 650      schema: { type: string }
 651
 652  responses:
 653    BadRequest:
 654      description: The request is malformed or fails validation.
 655      content:
 656        application/problem+json:
 657          schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Problem" }
 658          examples:
 659            invalidFields:
 660              dataValue:
 661                type: https://docs.brokerage.example/problems/invalid-request
 662                title: The request is not valid
 663                status: 400
 664                detail: One or more fields are invalid
 665                instance: /accounts/ACC-1001/orders
 666                requestId: 7f3c2a90-4a1e-4c1b-9d3e-2b8f1c6e0a11
 667                errors:
 668                  - { field: quantity, message: must be greater than 0 }
 669    Unauthorized:
 670      description: No valid bearer token. See WWW-Authenticate.
 671      headers:
 672        WWW-Authenticate:
 673          schema: { type: string }
 674      content:
 675        application/problem+json:
 676          schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Problem" }
 677    Forbidden:
 678      description: The token lacks the scope, or the order exceeds the client's trading limit.
 679      content:
 680        application/problem+json:
 681          schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Problem" }
 682    NotFound:
 683      description: The resource does not exist, or belongs to another customer.
 684      content:
 685        application/problem+json:
 686          schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Problem" }
 687    Conflict:
 688      description: The order's state does not allow this change.
 689      content:
 690        application/problem+json:
 691          schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Problem" }
 692    PreconditionFailed:
 693      description: The ETag in If-Match is stale.
 694      content:
 695        application/problem+json:
 696          schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Problem" }
 697    PreconditionRequired:
 698      description: If-Match is missing.
 699      content:
 700        application/problem+json:
 701          schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Problem" }
 702    UnprocessableContent:
 703      description: The request is well formed but breaks a business rule.
 704      content:
 705        application/problem+json:
 706          schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Problem" }
 707          examples:
 708            buyingPower:
 709              dataValue:
 710                type: https://docs.brokerage.example/problems/insufficient-buying-power
 711                title: The account does not have enough buying power
 712                status: 422
 713                detail: This order needs 250000.00 but only 52913.10 is available
 714                instance: /accounts/ACC-1001/orders
 715                requestId: b1b72c27-9103-4236-9cc0-c2b21d4d86bf
 716                required: "250000.00"
 717                available: "52913.10"
 718    TooManyRequests:
 719      description: The client's quota is used up.
 720      headers:
 721        Retry-After: { $ref: "#/components/headers/Retry-After" }
 722      content:
 723        application/problem+json:
 724          schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Problem" }
 725
 726  schemas:
 727    Decimal:
 728      description: An exact decimal number, as a string.
 729      type: string
 730      pattern: '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$'
 731      examples: ["187.50"]
 732    Link:
 733      type: object
 734      required: [href]
 735      properties:
 736        href: { type: string }
 737        templated: { type: boolean }
 738        type: { type: string }
 739        name: { type: string }
 740        title: { type: string }
 741    Links:
 742      description: HAL links, keyed by relation. A relation may hold one link or several.
 743      type: object
 744      properties:
 745        self: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Link" }
 746        curies:
 747          type: array
 748          items: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Link" }
 749      additionalProperties:
 750        anyOf:
 751          - $ref: "#/components/schemas/Link"
 752          - type: array
 753            items: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Link" }
 754    Templates:
 755      description: HAL-FORMS templates, present only for application/prs.hal-forms+json.
 756      type: object
 757      additionalProperties:
 758        type: object
 759        required: [method]
 760        properties:
 761          method: { type: string }
 762          contentType: { type: string }
 763          target: { type: string }
 764          properties: { type: array, items: { type: object } }
 765    Problem:
 766      description: An RFC 9457 problem document. Extension members depend on the type.
 767      type: object
 768      required: [type, title, status]
 769      properties:
 770        type: { type: string, format: uri }
 771        title: { type: string }
 772        status: { type: integer }
 773        detail: { type: string }
 774        instance: { type: string, format: uri-reference }
 775        requestId: { type: string }
 776        errors:
 777          type: array
 778          items:
 779            type: object
 780            required: [field, message]
 781            properties:
 782              field: { type: string }
 783              message: { type: string }
 784    ApiRoot:
 785      type: object
 786      required: [name, _links]
 787      properties:
 788        name: { type: string }
 789        description: { type: string }
 790        _links: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Links" }
 791    ProtectedResourceMetadata:
 792      type: object
 793      required: [resource, authorization_servers]
 794      properties:
 795        resource: { type: string, format: uri }
 796        resource_name: { type: string }
 797        authorization_servers: { type: array, items: { type: string, format: uri } }
 798        scopes_supported: { type: array, items: { type: string } }
 799        bearer_methods_supported: { type: array, items: { type: string } }
 800        tls_client_certificate_bound_access_tokens: { type: boolean }
 801
 802    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ accounts
 803    Account:
 804      type: object
 805      required: [id, number, type, registration, currency, _links]
 806      properties:
 807        id: { type: string }
 808        number:
 809          type: string
 810          description: Masked; only the last four digits are sent
 811          examples: ["****4821"]
 812        nickname: { type: string }
 813        type: { type: string, enum: [CASH, MARGIN] }
 814        registration: { type: string, enum: [INDIVIDUAL, JOINT, ROTH_IRA, TRADITIONAL_IRA] }
 815        currency: { type: string, pattern: "^[A-Z]{3}$" }
 816        openedOn: { type: string, format: date }
 817        _links: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Links" }
 818        _templates: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Templates" }
 819    AccountCollection:
 820      type: object
 821      required: [_links]
 822      properties:
 823        _embedded:
 824          type: object
 825          properties:
 826            bk:accounts: { type: array, items: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Account" } }
 827        _links: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Links" }
 828    Balances:
 829      type: object
 830      required: [accountId, currency, cash, reservedForOrders, buyingPower, positionsMarketValue,
 831        totalEquity, unrealizedPnl, asOf, _links]
 832      properties:
 833        accountId: { type: string }
 834        currency: { type: string }
 835        cash: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Decimal" }
 836        reservedForOrders: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Decimal" }
 837        buyingPower: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Decimal" }
 838        positionsMarketValue: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Decimal" }
 839        totalEquity: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Decimal" }
 840        unrealizedPnl: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Decimal" }
 841        asOf: { type: string, format: date-time }
 842        _links: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Links" }
 843    Position:
 844      type: object
 845      required: [instrumentId, symbol, instrumentType, quantity, averageCost, costBasis, lastPrice,
 846        marketValue, unrealizedPnl, unrealizedPnlPercent, _links]
 847      properties:
 848        instrumentId: { type: string }
 849        symbol: { type: string }
 850        instrumentType: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/InstrumentType" }
 851        quantity: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Decimal" }
 852        averageCost: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Decimal" }
 853        costBasis: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Decimal" }
 854        lastPrice: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Decimal" }
 855        marketValue: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Decimal" }
 856        unrealizedPnl: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Decimal" }
 857        unrealizedPnlPercent: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Decimal" }
 858        _links: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Links" }
 859    PositionCollection:
 860      type: object
 861      required: [_links]
 862      properties:
 863        _embedded:
 864          type: object
 865          properties:
 866            bk:positions: { type: array, items: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Position" } }
 867        _links: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Links" }
 868    TransactionType:
 869      type: string
 870      enum: [DEPOSIT, WITHDRAWAL, TRADE, DIVIDEND, FEE]
 871    Transaction:
 872      type: object
 873      required: [id, type, description, amount, occurredAt, settlesOn]
 874      properties:
 875        id: { type: string }
 876        type: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/TransactionType" }
 877        description: { type: string }
 878        amount: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Decimal", description: Positive into the account, negative out }
 879        instrumentId: { type: string }
 880        symbol: { type: string }
 881        quantity: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Decimal" }
 882        price: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Decimal" }
 883        orderId: { type: string }
 884        occurredAt: { type: string, format: date-time }
 885        settlesOn: { type: string, format: date }
 886    TransactionPage:
 887      type: object
 888      required: [_links]
 889      properties:
 890        _embedded:
 891          type: object
 892          properties:
 893            bk:transactions: { type: array, items: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Transaction" } }
 894        _links: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Links" }
 895
 896    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ market data
 897    InstrumentType:
 898      type: string
 899      enum: [EQUITY, ETF, OPTION]
 900    Instrument:
 901      type: object
 902      required: [id, symbol, name, type, currency, tradable, fractionable, multiplier, _links]
 903      properties:
 904        id: { type: string }
 905        symbol: { type: string }
 906        name: { type: string }
 907        type: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/InstrumentType" }
 908        exchange: { type: string, description: ISO 10383 market identifier code }
 909        currency: { type: string }
 910        tradable: { type: boolean }
 911        fractionable: { type: boolean }
 912        multiplier: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Decimal" }
 913        option:
 914          type: object
 915          required: [underlyingId, right, strike, expiration]
 916          properties:
 917            underlyingId: { type: string }
 918            underlyingSymbol: { type: string }
 919            right: { type: string, enum: [CALL, PUT] }
 920            strike: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Decimal" }
 921            expiration: { type: string, format: date }
 922            style: { type: string, enum: [AMERICAN, EUROPEAN] }
 923        _links: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Links" }
 924    InstrumentCollection:
 925      type: object
 926      required: [_links]
 927      properties:
 928        _embedded:
 929          type: object
 930          properties:
 931            bk:instruments: { type: array, items: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Instrument" } }
 932        _links: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Links" }
 933    QuoteV1:
 934      description: Version 1 (deprecated). Flat fields.
 935      type: object
 936      required: [instrumentId, symbol, last, bid, ask, bidSize, askSize, volume, asOf]
 937      properties:
 938        instrumentId: { type: string }
 939        symbol: { type: string }
 940        last: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Decimal" }
 941        bid: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Decimal" }
 942        ask: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Decimal" }
 943        bidSize: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Decimal" }
 944        askSize: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Decimal" }
 945        volume: { type: integer }
 946        asOf: { type: string, format: date-time }
 947        _links: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Links" }
 948    Quote:
 949      description: Version 2.
 950      type: object
 951      required: [instrumentId, symbol, last, bid, ask, change, changePercent, volume, asOf]
 952      properties:
 953        instrumentId: { type: string }
 954        symbol: { type: string }
 955        last: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Decimal" }
 956        bid: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/PriceLevel" }
 957        ask: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/PriceLevel" }
 958        change: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Decimal" }
 959        changePercent: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Decimal" }
 960        volume: { type: integer }
 961        asOf: { type: string, format: date-time }
 962        _links: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Links" }
 963    PriceLevel:
 964      type: object
 965      required: [price, size]
 966      properties:
 967        price: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Decimal" }
 968        size: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Decimal" }
 969
 970    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ orders
 971    OrderStatus:
 972      type: string
 973      enum: [OPEN, PARTIALLY_FILLED, FILLED, PENDING_CANCEL, CANCELLED, REJECTED]
 974    OrderSide:
 975      type: string
 976      enum: [BUY, SELL]
 977    OrderType:
 978      type: string
 979      enum: [MARKET, LIMIT, STOP, STOP_LIMIT]
 980    TimeInForce:
 981      type: string
 982      enum: [DAY, GTC]
 983      default: DAY
 984    OrderRequest:
 985      type: object
 986      required: [instrumentId, side, type, quantity]
 987      properties:
 988        instrumentId: { type: string, minLength: 1 }
 989        side: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/OrderSide" }
 990        type: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/OrderType" }
 991        timeInForce: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/TimeInForce" }
 992        quantity: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Decimal", description: Shares, or contracts for options }
 993        limitPrice: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Decimal", description: Required for LIMIT and STOP_LIMIT }
 994        stopPrice: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Decimal", description: Required for STOP and STOP_LIMIT }
 995        clientOrderId: { type: string, maxLength: 64, pattern: "^[A-Za-z0-9._-]*$" }
 996    OrderAmendment:
 997      type: object
 998      minProperties: 1
 999      properties:
1000        quantity: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Decimal" }
1001        limitPrice: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Decimal" }
1002        stopPrice: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Decimal" }
1003        timeInForce: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/TimeInForce" }
1004    Fill:
1005      type: object
1006      required: [id, quantity, price, executedAt]
1007      properties:
1008        id: { type: string }
1009        quantity: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Decimal" }
1010        price: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Decimal" }
1011        executedAt: { type: string, format: date-time }
1012    Order:
1013      type: object
1014      required: [id, accountId, instrumentId, symbol, instrumentType, side, type, timeInForce, quantity,
1015        status, filledQuantity, remainingQuantity, fills, createdAt, updatedAt, _links]
1016      properties:
1017        id: { type: string }
1018        accountId: { type: string }
1019        clientOrderId: { type: string }
1020        instrumentId: { type: string }
1021        symbol: { type: string }
1022        instrumentType: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/InstrumentType" }
1023        side: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/OrderSide" }
1024        type: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/OrderType" }
1025        timeInForce: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/TimeInForce" }
1026        quantity: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Decimal" }
1027        limitPrice: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Decimal" }
1028        stopPrice: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Decimal" }
1029        status: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/OrderStatus" }
1030        filledQuantity: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Decimal" }
1031        remainingQuantity: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Decimal" }

About this book

From the publisher

About the author

Smiroh Dev writes practical, standards-first guides for software engineers who build and secure web systems. Every Smiroh book is built around working code that runs on your own machine, because the best way to understand a standard is to watch it do its job.
